Entries.Title: How to Buy a Friend

Episodes.Title: The Angel's Mission
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo receives an invitation to Fantasia's anniversary party. After overhearing a suspicious phone call, she encounters Dan, an angel tasked with saving her life.

Episodes.Title: The Unwanted Guardian
Episodes.Description: Dan searches for his lost handkerchief at Yeon Seo's mansion. At Fantasia's party, Yeon Seo confronts pitying stares and makes a defiant decision.

Episodes.Title: A Final Chance
Episodes.Description: Dan saves Yeon Seo but angers the deity, risking dissolution. He gets one last chance as Seung Hwan dies in a car accident.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Giselle
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo becomes Fantasia's artistic director and appoints Yeon Seo as the lead for 'Giselle,' igniting tension with Ni Na.

Episodes.Title: Wings and Suspicions
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo glimpses Dan's wings but dismisses him as a pervert. Kang Woo enters her life, and Dan suspects him of malicious intent.

Episodes.Title: Columbarium Confessions
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo and Dan visit a columbarium, where rain forces them into closeness. Kang Woo urges Yeon Seo to dance again, but she uncovers his secret.

Episodes.Title: SNS Scandal
Episodes.Description: Dan is arrested after Yeon Seo reports him for trespassing. Ni Na's SNS post about Yeon Seo goes viral, forcing Kang Woo to address the fallout.

Episodes.Title: Walking Together
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo asks Dan to help her walk independently but misreads his intentions. Meanwhile, Kang Woo discovers Ni Na's hidden struggles.

Episodes.Title: A Rain-Soaked Kiss
Episodes.Description: Dan kisses Yeon Seo, triggering sudden rain. Yeon Seo promises Kang Woo to regain her form, while Ni Na confesses her feelings.

Episodes.Title: Celestial Taboo
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo questions Dan's feelings for Yeon Seo. Dan learns of a fallen angel who loved a human—a warning about his own growing emotions.

Episodes.Title: Driver's License Deception
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo urges Yeon Seo to attend Fantasia's Night. Dan becomes her chauffeur but struggles with human tasks, leading to chaos.

Episodes.Title: Sponsor Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo disrupts Fantasia's Night, angering sponsors. Dan suspects a setup, while Kang Woo investigates Yeong Ja's schemes.

Episodes.Title: Unfinished Business
Episodes.Description: Dan insists he can't disappear yet. Yeon Seo apologizes to sponsors, while Kang Woo reveals Ru Na's vote-buying plot.

Episodes.Title: Sanatorium Redemption
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo volunteers at a sanatorium to prove her sincerity. She proposes open auditions for 'Giselle,' challenging Fantasia's hierarchy.

Episodes.Title: Fallen Angel Revealed
Episodes.Description: Dan quits as Yeon Seo's secretary. Hu realizes Kang Woo is no ordinary human. Yeong Ja pressures Kang Woo to resign.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Confessions
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo drowns her longing for Dan in alcohol. Drunk, she revisits their first meeting place, leading to a raw emotional confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Island Memories
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo dreams of her childhood friend Seong Woo and travels to their island. Villagers reveal Dan's human past, deepening their connection.

Episodes.Title: Line Crossed
Episodes.Description: Dan vows to return to Yeon Seo. Kang Woo offers support, but she rebuffs him. Yeong Ja escalates her schemes against Fantasia.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Obsession
Episodes.Description: Hu uncovers Kang Woo's history as an angel who loved a human. Yeon Seo demands Dan's secrets, while Kang Woo exposes Ru Na's corruption.

Episodes.Title: Audition Showdown
Episodes.Description: Dan seeks a way to become human. Ni Na and Yeon Seo deliver stunning auditions. Kang Woo makes a dangerous pact with Yeon Seo.

Episodes.Title: Rooftop Amnesia
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo forgets a traumatic rooftop incident. Kang Woo suspects Yeong Ja and Ru Na of kidnapping, while Dan races to protect her.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Yeong Ja discovers Ru Na's murder plot. Ni Na volunteers as Yeon Seo's understudy. Yeon Seo follows Dan, uncovering his angelic truth.

Episodes.Title: Wings Exposed
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo remembers her kidnapping and confronts Dan about his identity. Yeong Ja disowns Ru Na, who faces legal consequences.

Episodes.Title: Mortal Price
Episodes.Description: Dan learns Yeon Seo must die for him to become human. Yeon Seo receives evidence implicating Yeong Ja, setting a final reckoning.

Episodes.Title: Boardroom Vengeance
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo ousts Yeong Ja and Ru Na from Fantasia. Ru Na begs for mercy, but Yeon Seo delivers cold justice for past crimes.

Episodes.Title: Picnic Proposal
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo and Dan revisit their first meeting park. She proposes marriage, believing it their only path—but Dan collapses from divine punishment.

Episodes.Title: Defying Heaven
Episodes.Description: Dan proposes to Yeon Seo, defying divine will. Elena manipulates Ni Na to harm Yeon Seo. Hu warns of catastrophic consequences.

Episodes.Title: Sacrificial Logic
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo reveals Yeon Seo must die to save Dan. Ni Na severs ties with her family, choosing ballet over blood.

Episodes.Title: Black Hole's Edge
Episodes.Description: Ki Joon Soo attempts to kill Dan, thwarted by Hu. Yeon Seo abandons Fantasia's performance to spend time with Dan, now fading rapidly.

Episodes.Title: Giselle's Swan Song
Episodes.Description: Ru Na attempts suicide. At Fantasia's show, Yeon Seo performs a transcendent 'Giselle,' unaware of Ni Na's sacrifice backstage.

Episodes.Title: Curtain Call
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo collapses post-performance. Ru Na, hospitalized, obsesses over Ni Na's role. Kang Woo and Hu intervene in Dan's fate.

Episodes.Title: Eternal Love
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo awakens to a dream of happiness with Dan. In reality, he bids farewell, urging her to live fully—a bittersweet celestial resolution.

Episodes.Description: Ingrid Yun joins Parsons Valentine & Hunt and immediately faces challenges when assigned to a high-stakes merger while navigating office politics.

Episodes.Title: Out of Office
Episodes.Description: Ingrid faces ethical dilemmas during a weekend retreat while competing against colleagues for a promotion opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Pro Forma
Episodes.Description: Ingrid takes leadership on a case but faces resistance from colleagues. Her personal life becomes complicated when family expectations collide with career ambitions.

Episodes.Title: Change of Venue
Episodes.Description: A case takes Ingrid to London where she must navigate cultural differences and office dynamics while managing a high-profile client.

Episodes.Title: Meta-Strategy
Episodes.Description: Ingrid develops a bold strategy for a case but faces opposition from senior partners. Office tensions rise as promotion decisions approach.

Episodes.Title: Talking Points
Episodes.Description: The firm faces a PR crisis that tests loyalties. Ingrid must choose between protecting her career or standing up for her principles.

Episodes.Title: Due Diligence
Episodes.Description: Ingrid discovers troubling information about a case that could jeopardize her career. Personal relationships reach breaking points.

Episodes.Title: Consequential Damages
Episodes.Description: A major case collapses, creating fallout throughout the firm. Ingrid confronts systemic discrimination while fighting to save her career.

Episodes.Title: Client Relations
Episodes.Description: As partnership decisions loom, Ingrid makes a final stand against the firm's power structure while confronting difficult truths about her career choices.

Entries.Title: Agila ng Maynila
Entries.Description: A classic Filipino action-drama series following the life of an urban hero fighting crime and corruption in Manila.

Episodes.Title: Disc 1
Episodes.Description: The beginning of the urban hero's journey as he takes on the criminal underworld of Manila.

Entries.Title: Dragon Village Episode
Entries.Description: A Korean animated fantasy series following magical dragon adventures in a mystical village, featuring colorful characters and exciting quests.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The magical world of Dragon Village is introduced as young dragons begin their first adventures.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The dragon friends face their biggest challenge yet as they work together to save their village.

Entries.Title: Love Online
Entries.Description: A digital romance story exploring modern relationships formed through online connections and virtual interactions.

Episodes.Title: Connection
Episodes.Description: Two strangers meet online and form an unexpected bond through digital communication.

Entries.Title: Disney's Fillmore!
Entries.Description: A middle school safety patrol unit solves crimes at X Middle School in this animated parody of police procedural dramas, featuring Cornelius Fillmore and Ingrid Third.

Episodes.Title: To Mar a Stall
Episodes.Description: Fillmore and Third investigate when someone sabotages the school's prized science project.

Episodes.Title: Two Wheels, Full Throttle, No Breaks
Of Slain Kings on Checkered Fields
South of Friendship, North of Honor
The Nineteenth Hole is a Shallow Grave
Links in a Chain of Honor
Field Trip of the Just
Episodes.Description: The final case takes Fillmore and Third on a field trip where they must solve one last mystery before graduating from X Middle School.

Entries.Title: Narco-Saints
Entries.Description: Based on true events, a civilian businessman gets recruited for a secret mission to capture a Korean drug lord operating in South America, plunging him into a dangerous world of narcotics and international crime.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Struggling businessman Kang In-gu travels to Suriname to export seafood but finds himself framed for drug trafficking by a powerful Korean drug lord.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After being imprisoned, In-gu is recruited by NIS agent Choi Chang-ho for a dangerous undercover mission to take down drug lord Jeon Yo-hwan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In-gu infiltrates Yo-hwan's organization, gaining his trust while navigating dangerous relationships with the drug lord's associates.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As In-gu goes deeper undercover, tensions rise between Yo-hwan and Colombian cartel members, putting the mission at risk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The operation reaches its climax as In-gu must betray Yo-hwan's trust while avoiding detection, leading to a violent confrontation.

Entries.Title: Alice in Borderland
Entries.Description: After an unexpected event transports them to a parallel Tokyo, Arisu and his friends must compete in deadly games to survive. Each game corresponds to playing card suits and numbers, testing their wits, courage, and morality.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Arisu and his friends find themselves in a deserted Tokyo where they must compete in a deadly game to survive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The group faces a high-stakes hide-and-seek game in an apartment building with a terrifying tagger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Arisu and Usagi team up for a game of trust in a botanical garden filled with lethal traps.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Players are forced to choose between light and dark in a game that tests their morality.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Arisu confronts the "Beach" faction's leader while a witch hunt game begins among the players.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Chaos erupts at the Beach as players try to identify the witch before time runs out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Arisu and Usagi enter a chilling game of tag with invisible enemies in an underground tunnel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The truth behind Borderland begins to unravel as Arisu confronts the gamemasters in a final showdown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Arisu and Usagi face the first face card game: King of Spades, a brutal military massacre.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Players compete in the Queen of Hearts' croquet game where psychological manipulation reigns.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A deadly game of Tokyo Beauty forces players to destroy what they cherish most.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Arisu enters the Jack of Hearts game where lies determine survival in a prison setting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Players battle in a samurai-themed castle for the King of Clubs, testing teamwork and sacrifice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The final face card games begin as Arisu confronts the Queen of Hearts in a psychological battle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Arisu must choose between reality and illusion in the Queen of Hearts' final game.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The origin of Borderland is revealed as survivors face their ultimate choice: stay or return.

Entries.Title: 3 Body Problem
Entries.Description: A groundbreaking sci-fi series exploring humanity's first contact with an alien civilization. As a young woman's pivotal decision in 1960s China echoes through space and time, a group of brilliant present-day scientists must unravel a mystery that threatens the very laws of physics and human existence.

Episodes.Title: Countdown
Episodes.Description: A mysterious suicide and strange phenomena lead scientists to discover an alien conspiracy spanning decades, with a countdown appearing before their eyes.

Episodes.Title: Red Coast
Episodes.Description: The connection between a 1960s Chinese military project and present-day scientific anomalies emerges as investigators uncover the Red Coast base's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Destroyer of Worlds
Episodes.Description: As the alien threat becomes clearer, scientists realize the invaders have already begun sabotaging Earth's technological progress.

Episodes.Title: Our Lord
Episodes.Description: A mysterious VR game reveals clues about the alien civilization's history as factions on Earth debate how to respond to the extraterrestrial threat.

Episodes.Title: Judgment Day
Episodes.Description: The world reacts to the alien revelation as the scientific team faces personal dangers and moral dilemmas about sharing their discovery.

Episodes.Title: The Stars Our Destination
Episodes.Description: Humanity plans its defense against the approaching alien fleet while confronting the limitations of known physics and technology.

Episodes.Title: Only Advance
Episodes.Description: As the alien fleet approaches, global alliances form and fracture, with humanity's survival hanging on controversial scientific breakthroughs.

Episodes.Title: Wallfacer
Episodes.Description: In the season finale, humanity initiates the Wallfacer Project - a last-ditch effort to outthink the alien invaders using unpredictable strategies.

Episodes.Title: Upcoming
Episodes.Description: Season 2 is currently in production. Details will be revealed later.

Entries.Title: A Poem A Day
Entries.Description: Physical therapists and radiologists navigate love, friendship, and healing through poetry at a hospital. The series explores emotional connections between medical staff and patients with poetic narration.

Episodes.Title: The Weight of Lightness, The Lightness of Weight
Episodes.Description: Physical therapist Woo Bo-young meets radiology resident Ye Jae-wook amid hospital tensions.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the First Snow
Episodes.Description: Bo-young helps a patient while navigating misunderstandings with Jae-wook.

Episodes.Title: To the Only One in the World
Episodes.Description: Bo-young treats a celebrity patient as tensions rise between hospital departments.

Episodes.Title: The Road Not Taken
Episodes.Description: Bo-young and Min-ho collaborate on a challenging rehabilitation case.

Episodes.Title: The Snow Is Falling
Episodes.Description: A snowy day brings unexpected confessions and poetic reflections at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Flower
Episodes.Description: Bo-young uses poetry therapy for a depressed patient while facing career decisions.

Episodes.Title: The Story of a Person Who Is Left Alone
Episodes.Description: Jae-wook confronts his past while treating an elderly patient with terminal illness.

Episodes.Title: The Flower
Episodes.Description: Team dynamics shift during a hospital festival preparation. Min-ho makes a heartfelt gesture.

Episodes.Title: That's What the World Is Like
Episodes.Description: A malpractice accusation threatens careers as relationships reach turning points.

Episodes.Title: The Day a Poem Is Forgotten
Episodes.Description: Final decisions about love and career are made through poignant goodbyes and new beginnings.

Entries.Title: Healer
Entries.Description: A mysterious night courier codenamed 'Healer' becomes entangled with an idealistic journalist and a legendary reporter while uncovering corruption tied to their parents' past. Together, they fight for truth while developing unexpected bonds.

Entries.Title: Goblin
Entries.Description: A 939-year-old immortal goblin seeks to end his cursed existence by finding his human bride. His life intertwines with a grim reaper and a cheerful high school girl who can see ghosts.

Episodes.Title: The Reason I Became a Goblin

Entries.Title: Fight For My Way
Entries.Description: Four childhood friends pursue their dreams while navigating adulthood, love, and career struggles. A former taekwondo athlete and an aspiring announcer support each other through failures and romantic entanglements.

Episodes.Title: The First Step of a Dream
The Night of the First Kiss
The Start of a Secret Romance
The First Step Toward the Dream
The First Step Toward the Future

Entries.Title: Descendants of the Sun
Entries.Description: A special forces captain and a talented surgeon navigate love and duty in a war-torn country while facing moral dilemmas and life-threatening situations.

Episodes.Title: A Reason to Save a Life
The More Precious, the More Dangerous

Entries.Title: City Hunter
Entries.Description: A skilled MIT graduate becomes a vigilante to uncover government corruption and avenge his father's death. Based on the Japanese manga, he navigates political conspiracies while protecting Seoul as the mysterious 'City Hunter'.

Entries.Title: Boys Over Flowers
Entries.Description: A poor but spirited girl gets entangled with four wealthy and powerful heirs at an elite high school. As she navigates bullying, friendship, and romance, her life changes forever when she captures the attention of the leader of the notorious F4 group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Poor scholarship student Geum Jan-di enters the elite Shinhwa High School and immediately clashes with the powerful F4 group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jan-di becomes the target of F4's bullying after standing up to Gu Jun-pyo. She receives the dreaded red card that marks her as an outcast.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's interest in Jan-di grows as she continues to defy him. Jan-di gets a job at the school cafeteria to support her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo arranges a trip to New Caledonia where tensions escalate between him and Jan-di. Ji-hoo comes to Jan-di's rescue during a crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Back from the trip, Jan-di tries to avoid Jun-pyo but finds herself unexpectedly indebted to him. Jun-pyo's sister makes her first appearance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's mother visits the school and takes an immediate dislike to Jan-di. Jan-di gets caught in a love triangle between Jun-pyo and Ji-hoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo officially declares his feelings for Jan-di. Jan-di's family faces financial trouble, leading to unexpected help from Ji-hoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo arranges a romantic birthday surprise for Jan-di. Jan-di begins to question her feelings as Jun-pyo's mother escalates her interference.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo takes Jan-di on a private date at his family's resort. The relationship faces its first major test when Jun-pyo's mother intervenes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jan-di's family faces eviction. Jun-pyo secretly helps them while dealing with his mother's schemes to separate him from Jan-di.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's mother threatens Jan-di's family business. Jan-di considers breaking up with Jun-pyo to protect her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A heartbroken Jun-pyo leaves for Macau after Jan-di's rejection. Jan-di follows him, realizing the depth of her feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo and Jan-di reconcile in Macau. Upon returning to Korea, they face new challenges from Jun-pyo's mother and a mysterious new transfer student.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's fiancée Seo-hyun arrives, creating tension. Jan-di struggles with jealousy while Jun-pyo tries to handle the arranged engagement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Seo-hyun's true feelings for Ji-hoo surface. Jan-di and Jun-pyo's relationship deepens as they face external pressures together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo takes a stand against his mother for Jan-di. The F4 face family pressures as their friendships are tested.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo is disinherited after defying his mother. He and Jan-di attempt to build a life together outside the Shinhwa empire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Struggling with poverty, Jun-pyo takes on menial jobs. Jan-di's family supports the couple while Jun-pyo's mother plots to break them up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo is injured protecting Jan-di. While he recovers, his mother manipulates events to make Jan-di believe she's endangering him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Jan-di makes a painful decision to leave Jun-pyo for his own good. A devastated Jun-pyo returns to his family and his destined path.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Four years later: Jan-di is now a medical intern. Jun-pyo returns from America transformed and engaged, setting up a dramatic reunion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo struggles with amnesia and his feelings for Jan-di. The F4 reunite as they help Jun-pyo recover his memories.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's memories return, reigniting his love for Jan-di. His mother escalates her efforts to maintain control through his engagement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo confronts his mother at his engagement party. The F4 unite to support their friend's pursuit of true love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: In the series finale, Jun-pyo and Jan-di fight for their future. Relationships are resolved as the F4 graduates from Shinhwa High.

Entries.Title: My Name
Entries.Description: Following her father's murder, a revenge-driven woman joins a powerful crime syndicate and infiltrates the police force as an undercover operative. As she descends deeper into the criminal underworld, she struggles to maintain her identity and uncovers shocking truths.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After witnessing her father's murder, Yoon Ji-woo seeks answers and joins a crime syndicate to uncover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ji-woo begins her brutal training under Choi Mujin's organization while Detective Jeon Pil-do investigates her father's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ji-woo infiltrates the police force as Oh Hye-jin, working alongside Pil-do while secretly reporting to Mujin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin struggles with her dual identity as she gets closer to both the police investigation and Mujin's operations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A major drug bust forces Hye-jin to confront her loyalties as tensions rise between the police and Mujin's organization.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin discovers devastating truths about her father's murder as her cover starts to unravel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: With her identity exposed, Ji-woo must choose between her mission for revenge and her newfound relationships.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: In the final confrontation, Ji-woo faces the architect of her tragedy and makes irreversible choices about her future.

Entries.Title: The Untamed
Entries.Description: A powerful demonic cultivator is resurrected 16 years after his death and reunites with a former ally to solve supernatural mysteries from their past in this xianxia fantasy based on the novel 'Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation'.

Entries.Title: Tom and Jerry

Episodes.Description: Tom gets scared by horror movies while trying to catch Jerry.

Episodes.Title: Dog Trouble

Episodes.Title: Puss n' Toots

Episodes.Title: Sufferin' Cats!
Episodes.Description: Tom competes with another cat to catch Jerry for a reward.

Episodes.Title: The Lonesome Mouse

Episodes.Title: Yankee Doodle Mouse

Episodes.Description: Tom is forced to dress as a baby when his owner has friends over.

Episodes.Title: The Zoot Cat
Episodes.Description: Tom tries to impress a female cat with zoot suit fashion.

Episodes.Title: The Million Dollar Cat
Episodes.Description: Tom inherits a fortune but must never harm mice to keep it.

Episodes.Title: The Bodyguard
Episodes.Description: Jerry hires a bulldog to protect him from Tom.

Episodes.Title: Puttin' on the Dog
Episodes.Description: Tom disguises himself as a dog to catch Jerry.

Episodes.Title: Mouse Trouble
Episodes.Description: Tom reads a book on mouse-catching with disastrous results.

Episodes.Title: The Mouse Comes to Dinner
Episodes.Description: Jerry crashes a fancy dinner party hosted by Tom's owners.

Episodes.Title: Mouse in Manhattan
Episodes.Description: Jerry explores New York City while Tom tries to find him.

Episodes.Title: Tee for Two
Episodes.Description: Golf-themed chase on a miniature course.

Episodes.Title: Flirty Birdy
Episodes.Description: A mother bird protects her nest from Tom with Jerry's help.

Episodes.Title: Quiet Please!
Episodes.Description: Jerry prevents Tom from making noise during his owner's nap.

Episodes.Description: Tom's romantic picnic is ruined by Jerry.

Episodes.Description: Tom uses increasingly elaborate traps to catch Jerry.

Episodes.Description: Jerry befriends a stray cat to protect himself from Tom.

Episodes.Description: Tom performs Liszt's Hungarian Rhapsody while Jerry disrupts from inside the piano.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Mouse
Episodes.Description: Chemical experiment turns Tom into different personalities.

Episodes.Title: Salt Water Tabby
Episodes.Description: Beach vacation turns into aquatic chaos.

Episodes.Description: Jerry outsmarts Tom using household items.

Episodes.Title: The Invisible Mouse
Episodes.Description: Jerry drinks an invisibility potion to evade Tom.

Episodes.Title: Kitty Foiled
Episodes.Description: Canary becomes Jerry's ally against Tom.

Episodes.Title: The Truce Hurts
Episodes.Description: Temporary peace treaty between Tom and Jerry breaks down spectacularly.

Episodes.Title: Old Rockin' Chair Tom
Episodes.Description: Elderly Tom competes with a younger cat for Jerry.

Episodes.Title: Professor Tom
Episodes.Description: Tom uses educational tools in creative ways to catch Jerry.

Entries.Title: The Bible
Entries.Description: A 10-part epic miniseries bringing to life the dramatic stories of faith and courage from Genesis through Revelation. Features state-of-the-art CGI and live-action recreations of iconic biblical events.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning
Episodes.Description: Covers Creation, Noah's Ark, Abraham's sacrifice, and the story of Moses' birth.

Episodes.Title: The Exodus
Episodes.Description: Moses confronts Pharaoh, leads the Israelites through the Red Sea, and receives the Ten Commandments.

Episodes.Title: The Homeland
Episodes.Description: Joshua conquers Jericho, Samson battles Philistines, and young David defeats Goliath.

Episodes.Title: The Kingdom
Episodes.Description: King Saul's downfall, David's reign as king, and Solomon's wisdom and temple.

Episodes.Title: The Survival
Episodes.Description: Nebuchadnezzar's siege of Jerusalem, Daniel in the lions' den, and the return from exile.

Episodes.Title: The Revolution
Episodes.Description: Jesus' birth, John the Baptist's ministry, and the calling of the first disciples.

Episodes.Title: The Mission
Episodes.Description: Jesus performs miracles, confronts Pharisees, and delivers the Sermon on the Mount.

Episodes.Title: The Betrayal
Episodes.Description: The Last Supper, Judas' betrayal, and Peter's denial of Jesus.

Episodes.Title: The Passion
Episodes.Description: Jesus' trial before Pilate and Caiaphas, crucifixion, and resurrection.

Episodes.Title: The Courage
Episodes.Description: The Holy Spirit descends at Pentecost, disciples spread the Gospel, and John receives Revelation.

Entries.Title: Queen's House
Entries.Description: A gripping historical drama series set in the royal court, following the political intrigues, romances, and power struggles surrounding the monarchy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The royal court prepares for a state visit while tensions rise between noble families vying for the Queen's favor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: The dramatic season finale where long-buried secrets come to light, changing the power dynamics of the royal court forever.

Entries.Title: Suits: South Korea
Entries.Description: The Korean adaptation of the popular US legal drama, following brilliant but unlicensed lawyer Go Yeon-woo and top attorney Choi Kang-seok as they navigate high-stakes corporate law cases in Seoul.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Top attorney Choi Kang-seok hires photographic memory genius Go Yeon-woo despite his lack of legal credentials, beginning their unconventional partnership.

Episodes.Title: Final Resolution
Episodes.Description: The season concludes with Kang-seok and Yeon-woo facing their biggest challenge yet as secrets are revealed and loyalties are tested.

Entries.Title: School 2017
Entries.Description: The seventh installment of KBS's 'School' series follows students at Seoran High School as they navigate academic pressures, friendship, first love, and a mysterious vigilante known as 'Student X'.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Introduction to Seoran High students and teachers, as mysterious notes from 'Student X' begin appearing, challenging the school's hierarchy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16 (Final)
Episodes.Description: The dramatic conclusion reveals Student X's identity as the students face their futures and say goodbye to Seoran High.

Entries.Title: Girls' Generation 1979
Entries.Description: Set in 1970s Daegu, this coming-of-age drama follows high school girl Lee Jung-hee as she navigates first love, friendship, and societal changes during Korea's turbulent political era.

Episodes.Title: First Love in Autumn
Episodes.Description: In 1979 Daegu, high schooler Lee Jung-hee's ordinary life changes when she meets transfer student Joo Young-hoon amidst the political tensions of the era.

Episodes.Title: Farewell My First Love
Episodes.Description: The series concludes as Jung-hee faces separation from Young-hoon against the backdrop of historical events, learning painful lessons about love and growing up.

Entries.Title: Kingdom
Entries.Description: In medieval Korea, a crown prince investigates a mysterious plague that resurrects the dead while fighting a political conspiracy to overthrow him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Crown Prince Lee Chang investigates the King's mysterious illness while a strange plague begins turning people into monsters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The prince flees the capital with his guard as the zombie plague spreads through the palace and surrounding villages.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Chang and his group discover the plague's connection to a rare plant while fighting infected villagers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The group takes refuge in a military camp as the undead horde grows, revealing new behaviors of the infected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Chang discovers the truth about his father's condition while the plague spreads to the wealthy province of Sangju.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The season climaxes with a massive zombie battle at Sangju as political enemies make their move against the prince.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Chang and his allies fight to retake Sangju while uncovering a conspiracy involving the resurrection plant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The group travels to a frozen lake where the plague originated while political enemies seize the capital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Chang confronts his stepmother Queen Consort Cho as the zombie horde breaches the capital's defenses.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The palace falls to the infected as Chang races to find the plant that could hold the cure to the plague.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A battle for the throne reaches its climax as the true origin of the plague is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The season finale reveals a new threat as survivors deal with the aftermath of the zombie outbreak.

Entries.Title: Madame Antoine
Entries.Description: A fake psychic and a cynical psychologist engage in a battle of wits when he uses her for a love experiment, leading to unexpected romantic entanglements and emotional discoveries.

Entries.Title: The Legend of the Blue Sea
Entries.Description: A mermaid from the Joseon period crosses centuries to meet a con artist in modern Seoul, unraveling a reincarnated love story haunted by their tragic past lives.

Episodes.Title: Prologue: Joseon Era
Episodes.Description: Historical backstory of nobleman Kim Dam-ryeong and mermaid Se-hwa's tragic romance in 1598.

Episodes.Title: Encounter in Spain
Episodes.Description: Con artist Heo Joon-jae meets a mysterious mermaid while fleeing authorities in Spain.

Episodes.Title: Stranger in Seoul
Episodes.Description: Joon-jae brings the mermaid to Korea, naming her Shim Cheong as she adapts to human world.
Shim Cheong's supernatural abilities surface while Joon-jae investigates her origins.
Joon-jae discovers Cheong's mermaid identity as past-life memories intensify.
Cheong faces danger from Joon-jae's stepbrother while developing human emotions.
Joon-jae protects Cheong from threats as their past-life connection becomes clearer.
Cheong experiences human heartbreak while Joon-jae confronts family secrets.
Parallel timelines reveal Joseon-era tragedy mirroring modern conflicts.
Cheong's mermaid powers weaken as human emotions deepen.
Joon-jae chooses between wealth and protecting Cheong from enemies.
Cheong makes a sacrifice to save Joon-jae, triggering past-life memories.
Full recollection of Joseon-era betrayal puts current relationships at risk.
Cheong disappears after learning the truth about her past-life death.

Entries.Title: X-Men (Marvel Anime)
Entries.Description: The X-Men, grieving the death of Jean Grey, travel to Japan to investigate the disappearance of a mutant student. They uncover a conspiracy involving the U-Men and the Inner Circle, who are exploiting a virus that mutates victims into monstrous forms.

Episodes.Title: The Return...Joining Forces
Episodes.Description: Professor X recruits a reluctant Cyclops to help find a missing mutant student in Japan after Jean Grey's death.

Episodes.Title: U-Men...Mutant Hunting
Episodes.Description: The X-Men discover widespread anti-mutant prejudice in Japan and battle the U-Men, who are experimenting on mutants.

Episodes.Title: Armor...Awakening
Episodes.Description: The X-Men rescue Hisako and Emma Frost from the U-Men, triggering Hisako's mutant powers during a battle with scientist Todd.

Episodes.Title: Transformation...Secondary Mutation
Episodes.Description: Emma Frost reveals a diamond form to protect Hisako, showcasing a secondary mutation. The team is attacked by a bat-creature mid-flight.

Episodes.Title: Power...Unity
Episodes.Description: Hisako trains as an X-Man while Emma undergoes telepathic examination to prove her trustworthiness.

Episodes.Title: Conflict...Contested
Episodes.Description: Returning to Japan with a vaccine, the X-Men crash-land and battle remaining U-Men forces.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal...Shock
Episodes.Description: The X-Men reach Yui Sasaki's facility, where she reveals Professor X is the father of her deceased son.

Episodes.Title: Lost...Signs
Episodes.Description: Yui's assistants succumb to mutation. Professor X disappears en route to Japan.

Episodes.Title: Revelations...From Behind the Scenes
Episodes.Description: Emma uncovers Jun as Mastermind, leader of the Inner Circle, who manipulates Wolverine into attacking Cyclops.

Episodes.Title: Countdown...Truth
Episodes.Description: The X-Men battle Mastermind's Four Pillars, while Yui reveals the truth about her son Takeo.

Episodes.Title: Revenge...End
Episodes.Description: Takeo's reality-warping powers threaten the world, overwhelming the X-Men.

Episodes.Title: Destiny...Bond
Episodes.Description: Professor X confronts Takeo on the astral plane in a final effort to save humanity from destruction.

Entries.Title: Magic Kaito 1412
Entries.Description: Kaito Kuroba discovers his father was the Phantom Thief Kid, murdered for seeking the mystical Pandora Gem. Taking up his father's mantle, he performs heists to lure out the secret organization while mastering stage magic and evading detective pursuers.

Entries.Title: I Wanna Hear Your Song

Entries.Title: Fat Albert and the Cosby Kids
Entries.Description: Fat Albert and the Cosby Kids is an American animated television series created, produced, and hosted (in live action bookend segments) by comedian Bill Cosby, who also lent his voice to a number of characters, including Fat Albert and himself. Filmation was the production company for the series. The show premiered in 1972 and ran until 1985 (with new episodes being produced sporadically). The show, based on Cosby's remembrances of his childhood gang, centered on Fat Albert (known for his catchphrase 'Hey, hey, hey!') and his friends.

Entries.Title: Cardcaptors

Entries.Title: Robotomy
Entries.Description: Robotomy was a Cartoon Network American animated television series created by Michael Buckley & Joe Deasy, directed by Christy Karacas (Superjail!), voice directed by Michael Sinterniklaas, and produced by World Leaders Entertainment. The series was developed after a long series of unaccepted ideas, and occasionally put in and out of production due to changing executives.It was officially announced on August 13th, 2010 and premiered on October 25th, 2010. Robotomy was canceled on January 24, 2011 due to production costs and low foreign appeal. Thrasher and Blastus are two outsider robots that live on the planet of Insanus (originally called Killglobe). Insanus is a planet inhabited by murderous robots who seek to kill one another for no apparent reason. Slightly less horrific than their peers, the duo seek to make it through high school, and navigate their lives with varying degrees of success. While Thrasher wishes to gain the affections of an attractive female robot named Maimy, Blastus just wants to be recognized as popular.

Entries.Description: Dexter Douglas is a mild-mannered teenager who, one snowy afternoon, while logged onto the Internet, is thrust into a horrible crash on the information superhighway and transformed into an electrifying superhero. He's average, predictable, the middle of the bell curve and the center of the silent majority -- basically he's completely dull and boring! There's simply nothing extraordinary about Dexter Douglas. He's just a kind-hearted guy who blends into the crowd easily -- except when he's "Freakazoid"! With his new power and the support of fan boy and his other friends he will stop the evil lobe and the other evil doers and all in time to lock lips with the sexy Steff. Entries.Title: Ultimate Muscle
Entries.Description: Mantaro Muscle (also known as Kid Muscle, Mantaro Kinniku in the Japanese version) is the spoiled son of superhero wrestler King Muscle (Kinnikuman in the Japanese version). After 28 years of peace, the Seigi Choujins' (Muscle League) old enemies regroup and form the Demon Manufacturing Plant (dMp, known in the English version as Destruction, Mayhem and Pain). The Muscle League has lost its edge and are overwhelmed by the young, well-trained fighters. Recognizing their weakness, the Seigi Chojin reopen the Hercules Factory (a school for superheroes) and begin training a new generation of heroes to take on the dMp. At first unwilling, Mantaro (Kid Muscle) is one of the young heroes and defeats his father to prove his readiness to graduate. He and the other new Seigi Choujin defeat several members of the dMp and meet Kevin Mask, who quits dMp when he discovers their lack of honor. They also battle Sunshine and his pupils, who destroy the dMp after developing a renewed respect for the fighting spirit of the Seigi Choujins.

Entries.Title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend
Entries.Description: Yaiba Kurogane, a young samurai trained in the jungle, moves to Japan and stays with the Mine family. His quest to become a true warrior leads to a rivalry with kendo champion Takeshi Onimaru, awakening supernatural swords—Fujinken (Wind God's Sword) and Raijinken (Thunder God's Sword)—that reignite ancient conflicts. With allies like Sayaka Mine and his pet tiger Kagetora, Yaiba battles demons and historical figures while mastering the Hyōhō Niten Ichi-ryū sword style inspired by Miyamoto Musashi.

Episodes.Title: Meeting Yaiba
Episodes.Description: Jungle-trained samurai Yaiba moves to Japan with his father and pet tiger. After causing chaos at the airport, he stays with the Mine family and meets Sayaka. At her school, he clashes with kendo champion Takeshi Onimaru, awakening two mythical swords.

Episodes.Title: Fujinken Reborn
Episodes.Description: Yaiba provokes Onimaru into dueling by vandalizing his pigeon pen. The confrontation awakens the Fujinken's power, escalating their rivalry.

Episodes.Title: Another Maken
Episodes.Description: After losing to Onimaru, Yaiba seeks a magical sword in the mountains to match the Raijinken's power.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Eight Ogres
Episodes.Description: Onimaru summons demons to hunt the Raijinken while Yaiba trains with Musashi to master his new sword.

Episodes.Title: Onsen Fun
Episodes.Description: Yaiba's group searches for Sasaki Kojiro's sword on Ganryujima. They defeat a slug demon and relax at a hot spring.

Episodes.Title: The Unexpected Mr. Bat
Episodes.Description: In Nagoya, the group battles Mr. Bat, who covets the Raijinken. He bites Musashi's neck during the fight.

Episodes.Title: Kojiro Resurrected
Episodes.Description: At Ganryujima, the team confronts Mr. Spider and a resurrected Sasaki Kojiro, who is furious about his revival.

Episodes.Title: The Duel at Ganryu Island
Episodes.Description: Musashi and Kojiro must duel as history dictates for Yaiba to return to his timeline, but Yaiba's interference risks altering events.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of the Lightning Slash
Episodes.Description: Yaiba trains with Musashi and Kojiro to develop a sword technique capable of countering Onimaru's demonic powers.

Episodes.Title: Onimaru's Devil Kings
Episodes.Description: Yaiba's team storms Onimaru Castle but falls into a trap, facing his new henchmen in the fortress depths.

Entries.Title: Rambo: The Force of Freedom
Entries.Description: Colonel Samuel Trautman assembles a team of specialists led by John Rambo to combat the evil forces of S.A.V.A.G.E., led by the ruthless General Warhawk.

Entries.Title: Exosquad
Entries.Description: The series is set in the years 2119–2121 AD, decades after humanity ('Terrans') has expanded beyond Earth, terraforming and colonizing Venus and Mars.

Entries.Description: Pokémon Chronicles is a spin-off series of the Pokémon anime, revolving around characters other than Ash Ketchum.

Entries.Title: Garfield and Friends
Entries.Description: Garfield and Friends is an American animated television series based on the comic strip Garfield by Jim Davis. The show was produced by Film Roman, in association with United Media in season 1, and United Media/Mendelson in seasons 2–6. The show aired on CBS as part of its Saturday morning children's lineup from September 17, 1988 to December 10, 1994.

Entries.Title: Fireman Sam
Entries.Description: British animated series following heroic firefighter Sam and his team as they protect the Welsh village of Pontypandy from fires and other emergencies.

Entries.Title: Sakamoto Days
Entries.Description: Taro Sakamoto, once the world's most feared hitman, retires to run a convenience store after falling in love. When his violent past resurfaces, he must protect his family using non-lethal methods while navigating comedic and action-packed threats.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members handle a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood in a prison cell.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto battles Kashima intensely.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Description: Description not available from sources.

Entries.Title: Home Movies
Entries.Description: Follows eight-year-old Brendon Small who creates homemade movies with friends while navigating life with his divorced mother and eccentric soccer coach.

Entries.Title: Witch at Court
Entries.Description: A headstrong prosecutor specializing in sex crimes teams up with a former child psychiatrist to solve brutal cases while confronting a corrupt mayor linked to her mother's disappearance. The duo uses unorthodox methods to deliver justice in a system stacked against victims.

Episodes.Title: The Witch Rises
Episodes.Description: Ma Yi-Deum joins the sex crimes unit and clashes with principled colleague Yeo Jin-Wook during their first case involving a serial rapist.

Episodes.Title: Fabricated Truth
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum's ruthless tactics backfire as she fabricates evidence. The team investigates a hospital assault case with political connections.

Episodes.Title: Past Shadows
Episodes.Description: A celebrity sexual assault case reveals ties to Mayor Jo Gap-soo. Yi-Deum confronts trauma from her mother's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Web of Power
Episodes.Description: The team uncovers a human trafficking ring protected by high-ranking officials. Jin-Wook's psychiatric skills prove critical.

Episodes.Title: Beneath the Mask
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum goes undercover at a charity gala to expose a predator. Flashbacks reveal Mayor Jo's history of sexual torture.

Episodes.Title: Daughter's Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: A victim's suicide forces Yi-Deum to reconsider her methods. The team discovers evidence linking Jo to 20-year-old crimes.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal of Trust
Episodes.Description: A prosecutor within their unit is accused of assault. Yi-Deum and Jin-Wook race to prevent evidence tampering by Jo's network.

Episodes.Title: Witness Hunt
Episodes.Description: The team protects a key witness against Jo's forces. Yi-Deum's childhood friend emerges with crucial information about her mother.

Episodes.Title: Unholy Alliance
Episodes.Description: Jo manipulates the media to discredit the task force. Yi-Deum forms a risky partnership with a corrupt lawyer to infiltrate his circle.

Episodes.Title: Judgment Day
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum takes the stand in a high-stakes trial against Jo's protégé. Secret documents surface exposing systemic cover-ups.

Episodes.Title: Echoes of Torture
Episodes.Description: A survivor from Min Ji-sook's past case provides new testimony. Yi-Deum discovers her mother was Jo's original accuser.

Episodes.Title: Sacrificial Pawn
Episodes.Description: Jo frames Jin-Wook for evidence tampering. The team must clear his name while preventing the destruction of critical documents.

Episodes.Title: Burn the Witch
Episodes.Description: Public backlash threatens the unit's dissolution. Yi-Deum confronts Jo in a televised debate revealing his psychological profile.

Episodes.Title: Graveyard Secrets
Episodes.Description: The team excavates a burial site containing evidence of Jo's past crimes. A key witness disappears under mysterious circumstances.

Episodes.Title: Final Gambit
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum risks disbarment by leaking classified documents. Jin-Wook discovers medical proof linking Jo to the torture victims.

Episodes.Title: The Court of Redemption
Episodes.Description: In the climactic trial, Yi-Deum faces Jo's empire of corruption. The team presents a decade-spanning case to deliver justice for all victims.

Entries.Title: The Real Has Come!
Entries.Description: A skilled instructor gets entangled in a fake relationship with a commitment-phobic man, leading to unexpected pregnancy complications that disrupt their carefully constructed lies.

Entries.Title: Three Bold Siblings
Entries.Description: A heartwarming story of Kim Tae-joo, a doctor and eldest sibling, who reunites with her first love Lee Sang-joon, a popular actor, amidst family secrets, corporate intrigues, and romantic entanglements.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju confronts family tensions during So Rim's engagement dinner while sacrificing her own desires for her siblings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju and So Rim clash after the disastrous dinner, leading Tae Ju to evict So Rim from her apartment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun is saved from a stalker by Tae Ju's intervention, rekindling their complex past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju struggles with lingering feelings after Sang Jun's sincere apology disrupts her life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A dating show featuring Tae Ju and Sang Jun blurs lines between reality and performance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The dating show spirals into chaos, forcing Tae Ju to confront unexpected stressors.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun's apology visit turns chaotic when Tae Ju's mother intervenes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju bonds with her uncle Myeong Jae, only to discover his betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju faces financial ruin after her uncle's scam, forcing her to relocate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jung Sook discovers Tae Ju's struggles and invites her to live together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju realizes her feelings for Sang Jun, who suddenly avoids her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju confronts Sang Jun at Se Ran's home, causing a public scene.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Sang Min clashes with Tae Ju at a family gathering, escalating tensions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Sang Min's marriage fraud scheme unravels, revealing hidden connections.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun plans to visit Tae Ju's house, while So Rom develops feelings for a colleague.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Se Ran feels threatened by Tae Ju and sabotages her relationship with Sang Jun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun moves in with Tae Ju, shocking Se Ran and deepening family rifts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun brings Tae Ju home, where Eun Ju and Se Ran scheme against her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju and Sang Jun secretly marry while their mothers unknowingly bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: The couple prepares to reveal their marriage as past secrets resurface.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju receives a threatening letter, prompting Sang Jun to hire bodyguards.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Mu Yeong's Christmas gift causes family speculation; Ji Hye investigates So Rim's ex.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Family celebration reveals shocking connections between characters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Nam Soo suspects So Rim's relationship with Mu Yeong; Sang Min confronts Dong Chan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju recognizes Jang Mi; Eun Ju discovers a dark secret about Ji Woo's birth mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Jang Mi harasses Sang Jun's family; So Rim is framed by Nam Soo using company data.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: So Rim discovers Mu Yeong is CEO; Jang Mi threatens Se Ran about Ji Woo's parentage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jung's secret pregnancy causes turmoil; Tae Ju intervenes to stop her departure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun finds Tae Ju injured; Young Sik investigates security footage for clues.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Ji Hye plots to expose So Rim and Mu Yeong's relationship after learning the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun seeks to restore Tae Ju's memory and reports the attacker seen on security footage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Jang Mi reveals Ji Woo's parentage; Sang Jun learns he is the biological father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun distances himself from family after losing trust; Tae Ju struggles with amnesia.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun considers self-sacrifice; Tae Ju grows suspicious of his behavior.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju investigates Sang Jun's motives; Hyun Jung's plan to leave Gun Woo fails.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Tae Ju discovers Sang Jun's paternity dilemma and demands a DNA test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Hyun Jung confirms feelings for Gun Woo; Mu Yeong and So Rim's relationship is exposed online.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Ji Woo's isolation reminds Tae Ju of her past; DNA test results arrive, causing turmoil.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Ji Hye reunites with her mother; So Rim formally introduces Mu Yeong to her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Ji Woo runs away from family stress; Tae Ju and Sang Jun find him at a meaningful location.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Ji Woo bonds with Tae Ju; Mu Yeong prioritizes So Rim over his ex-wife's illness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Reporters swarm Young Sik's studio over Ji Woo's parentage scandal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun plans legal action against Young Sik; Hee Eun's faked illness is exposed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: So Rim takes over the curry restaurant after quitting her job and breaking up with Mu Yeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun and Tae Ju uncover proof of Hee Eun's fraud, investigating her fake doctor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Family confronts the aftermath of Hee Eun's exposure; relationships are tested.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Sang Jun and Tae Ju work to reconcile their families amidst ongoing conflicts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Final efforts to heal rifts lead to emotional confrontations and revelations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: The families gather for resolutions as lingering secrets are fully resolved.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Climactic decisions about futures and relationships culminate in a family summit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51 (Series Finale)
Episodes.Description: Conclusion of all storylines: love triumphs, families reunite, and new beginnings unfold.

Entries.Title: The Queen of Office
Entries.Description: A talented contract worker at a company becomes a legendary temporary employee who changes the lives of those around her while navigating office politics and personal challenges.

Entries.Title: Soul Mechanic
Entries.Description: A talented psychiatrist with his own emotional wounds forms an unconventional therapeutic relationship with a volatile musical actress suffering from rage disorder, helping each other heal through unexpected connections.

Entries.Title: Puberty Medley
Entries.Description: A nostalgic coming-of-age film following four teenagers navigating first loves, friendships, and personal growth during their transformative high school years in the 1980s.

Entries.Title: Hajimete no Gal
Entries.Description: A high school student desperate to lose his virginity confesses to a popular gyaru, beginning an unlikely relationship that challenges his social anxieties and perceptions of love.

Entries.Title: Grimgar: Ashes and Illusions
Entries.Description: A group of strangers awakens in a mysterious fantasy world with no memories. Forced to join the Reserve Army to survive, they struggle to adapt to their harsh reality while battling monsters and confronting the fragility of life.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the New Moon

Entries.Title: Dream of 400 Years
Entries.Description: Kang Hee Sun, a professor at Hanbaek Medical School, is called to investigate when a mummy is discovered in a sealed room in a traditional Korean house. Upon meeting Jo Hyun Min, the owner, both feel an unexplainable connection that soon leads to mysterious and supernatural events. Bittersweet fantasy romance, part of the KBS Drama Special Series.

Entries.Title: Special Task Force MSS
Entries.Description: A team of MSS (independent) detectives, labelled as troublemakers at their respective police stations, attempt to track down a serial killer. At the forefront is No Chul Gi, who refuses to give up on the case and adamantly insists on reinvestigation despite opposition. A blend of action, mystery, and crime, broadcast as part of KBS Drama Special Series.

Entries.Title: Suji & Uri
Entries.Description: A heartwarming Korean family drama following the lives of two sisters, Suji and Uri, as they navigate relationships, career challenges, and family bonds in modern-day Seoul.

Episodes.Title: I'm too offended to eat your food
Jintae got a matching tie pin

Entries.Title: Hagure Yuusha no Aesthetica
Entries.Description: After defeating the Dark Lord in an alternate world, hero Akatsuki Ousawa returns to Earth with the Dark Lord's daughter, Miu. They enroll in BABEL, a special academy training otherworld returnees, where Akatsuki must navigate school life while protecting Miu from those who seek her power.

Episodes.Title: The Strongest Man on Earth Returns
The First Step to Becoming a Hero
A Trap and a Maiden's Heart
The Academy's Strongest vs. the Strongest in Another World
The Darkness That Shakes the Heart
The Aesthetica of a Rogue Hero

Entries.Title: Gunman in Joseon
Entries.Description: In 19th-century Joseon, swordsman Park Yoon-kang (Lee Joon-gi) trades his blade for a gun to avenge his family's murder. As political factions clash during Korea's rapid modernization, he evolves from a vengeful son to a revolutionary hero protecting his people.

Episodes.Title: The Rebel Gunman
Episodes.Description: A rebel gunman terrorizes the capital, assassinating Enlightenment scholars. Park Yoon-kang's father hunts the killer amid dangerous political games.

Episodes.Title: The Chase
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang intervenes in Soo-in's affairs, leading both to be pursued by the master gunman for Hyun Am's revolutionary book.

Episodes.Title: Kidnapped
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang develops feelings for Soo-in, but his sister is kidnapped during their growing connection.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang realizes he misunderstood his father, but faces greater peril as his family is targeted by assassins.

Episodes.Title: Return of Hanjo
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang returns as Hasegawa Hanjo, a Japanese businessman with a dark past. Soo-in attempts to acquire a camera while suspecting his identity.

Episodes.Title: Unmasking
Episodes.Description: Soo-in confronts Hanjo about his identity, while Won-shin devises a test to confirm if Hanjo is Yoon-kang.

Episodes.Title: Allies and Enemies
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang reveals himself to an ally to find his sister. Won-shin closes in on confirming Hanjo's true identity.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang risks exposure to save his sister. Soo-in attempts a dangerous explosion demonstration.

Episodes.Title: Royal Investigation
Episodes.Description: The royal court investigates a minister's murder, endangering Yoon-kang. Won-shin's suspicions escalate after Yeon-ha's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Torture and Rescue
Episodes.Description: Soo-in and her father are tortured by corrupt officials. Yoon-kang intervenes to save them, risking his cover.

Episodes.Title: The Assassination Attempt
Episodes.Description: Ho-kyung is injured during an attack on Interpreter Jung. Yoon-kang identifies his father's killer.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang's identity is exposed. Hye-won threatens her father after learning about his crimes against Yoon-kang.

Episodes.Title: Captured
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang captures Won-shin, but corrupt officials intervene. Hye-won protects her father during an assassination attempt.

Episodes.Title: The King's Mercy
Episodes.Description: King Gojong orchestrates Yoon-kang's escape from execution. Political tensions escalate as rebels target the throne.

Episodes.Title: Father and Daughter
Episodes.Description: Hye-won searches for her wounded father. Yoon-kang and Soo-in uncover evidence of government corruption.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Conservatives incite a rebellion, endangering the king and queen. Yoon-kang thwarts Hye-won's attack on Soo-in.

Episodes.Title: Power Play
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang kidnaps Kim Jwa-young. Hye-won tries to stop her father from assassinating the queen.

Episodes.Title: Trade Wars
Episodes.Description: Yoon-kang sabotages Won-shin's business deals with Japanese merchants. The king brands Yoon-kang a criminal.

Episodes.Title: Framed
Episodes.Description: Japanese forces demand Yoon-kang's arrest. Won-shin plots to eliminate him during the chaos.

Episodes.Title: Court Intrigue
Episodes.Description: Soo-in becomes a court maid to aid the rebellion. Yoon-kang plans a coup with progressive allies.

Episodes.Title: Coup
Episodes.Description: Rebels seize the palace amid city-wide chaos. Won-shin survives an assassination attempt.

Episodes.Title: The Price of Freedom
Episodes.Description: Japanese troops invade Joseon. Yoon-kang confronts allies about foreign interference while securing a future for his people.

Entries.Title: The Elegant Empire
Entries.Description: A powerful revenge story about individuals fighting against overwhelming power to reclaim their stolen lives, uncovering hidden truths while navigating corporate intrigue and personal betrayals.

Episodes.Title: The Memorial Intrigue
Episodes.Description: During Jang Chang Sung's memorial service, Jang Gi Yun expands his inherited company while a mysterious woman resembling his past appears.

Episodes.Title: Doppelganger Arrival
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae encounters Gi Yun while being pursued, sparking his interest. Her arrival at NA Entertainment causes confusion due to her resemblance to Ju Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Photographic Evidence
Episodes.Description: Seung Pil photographs Gi Yun and Hee Jae together, sending evidence to Jaclyn who recognizes the resemblance to Ju Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Model Showdown
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae secures Hyunta as Miyu Cosmetics model, infuriating Gi Yun and Jaclyn. Gi Yun investigates Hee Jae's background.

Episodes.Title: Provocations
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk grapples with feelings for Ju Kyung while Hee Jae provokes Jaclyn by hinting at her influence over Woo Hyuk.

Episodes.Title: Fake Love Revealed
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun's confession of fake love to Ju Kyung revealed as strategic manipulation to gain his father's forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Shattered Happiness
Episodes.Description: Ju Kyung's happy life with daughter Soo A is disrupted when she discovers Gi Yun with another woman.

Episodes.Title: Corporate Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: Seung Pil conspires with Jaclyn to steal Gi Yun's company, leading to confrontations at a hotel.

Episodes.Title: New Beginning
Episodes.Description: First episode with Lee Si-kang as Jang Ki-yoon following actor change

Episodes.Title: Centennial Climax
Episodes.Description: Revenge plots reach boiling point as alliances shift and hidden motives are exposed in the 100th episode milestone.

Episodes.Title: Elegant Finale
Episodes.Description: The empire's fate is decided as all secrets are revealed and final confrontations determine the characters' destinies.

Entries.Title: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
Entries.Description: In the year After Colony 195, five teenage pilots are sent to Earth in advanced mobile suits called Gundams to wage war against the oppressive United Earth Sphere Alliance. As conflicts escalate, they become entangled in complex political machinations while questioning the nature of their missions.

Entries.Title: Golden Cross
Entries.Description: A financial analyst seeks revenge against a powerful conglomerate he believes drove his sister to suicide, uncovering a web of corporate corruption and conspiracy.

Entries.Title: Girls Generation 1979
Entries.Description: Set in 1970s Daegu, this coming-of-age drama follows a group of high school girls navigating friendship, first love, and societal pressures during Korea's military dictatorship era.

Entries.Title: Bridal Mask
Entries.Description: During the Japanese occupation of Korea in the 1930s, a police officer secretly becomes the masked hero 'Gaksital' to fight for Korean independence while maintaining his cover as a collaborator.

The Man Who Discovers His Father

Entries.Title: Born Again
Entries.Description: A reincarnation-themed romance thriller spanning two timelines (1980s and present day), where a detective, an antique shop owner, and a prosecutor's fates intertwine across lifetimes amidst murder mysteries and forbidden love.

Entries.Title: Beauty and Mr. Romantic
Entries.Description: A top actress falls from grace overnight, and a rookie director helps her rebuild her career while confronting family secrets and revenge plots.

Episodes.Title: Do Ra Meets Dae Chung
Episodes.Description: Thirteen-year-old Do Ra runs into Dae Chung and falls in love. Her mother forces her into acting to escape poverty.

Episodes.Title: Forced Breakup
Episodes.Description: Geum Ja reveals Dae Chung's birth secret. Mi Ja steals food from Dae Chung's family.

Episodes.Title: Jun Sub And A Woman
Episodes.Description: Geum Ja sees Jun Sub with another woman. Do Ra calls Dae Chung for help against bullies.

Episodes.Title: Pil Seung’s New Main Lead
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung (adult Dae Chung) becomes a drama director. Do Ra refuses a role in his drama.

Episodes.Title: Do Ra's Revenge Plan
Episodes.Description: Do Ra flirts with Bong Soo to spite Bi Bi, disappointing Pil Seung.

Episodes.Title: Birth Secret Revealed
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung discovers his adoption truth. Do Ra confronts her mother about past choices.

Episodes.Title: Family Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung demands answers from his parents. Do Ra's mother schemes to control her career.

Episodes.Title: On-Set Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Bi Boo sabotages Do Ra's performance. Pil Seung protects Do Ra from a falling light.

Episodes.Title: Hospital Confession
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung confesses feelings to injured Do Ra. Jin Dan discovers their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail Scheme
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan blackmails Do Ra with stolen documents. Pil Seung's mother interferes with production.

Episodes.Title: Contract Termination
Episodes.Description: Do Ra faces contract termination. Pil Seung publicly defends her at a press conference.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Secret
Episodes.Description: Do Ra discovers her mother stole from Dae Chung's family. Jin Dan leaks their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Public Scandal
Episodes.Description: Do Ra's career collapses after scandal. Pil Seung confronts Jin Dan about the leak.

Episodes.Title: Disappearance
Episodes.Description: Do Ra disappears after scandal. Pil Seung searches desperately while Jin Dan celebrates.

Episodes.Title: Broken Engagement
Episodes.Description: Do Ra breaks up with Pil Seung and agrees to marry Jin Dan, but cancels the engagement last-minute.

Episodes.Title: Two Years Later
Episodes.Description: After Do Ra's presumed death, Pil Seung becomes a director. Jin Dan suffers nightmares. Pil Seung meets Ji Young (amnesiac Do Ra).

Episodes.Title: Memory Fragments
Episodes.Description: Ji Young experiences flashbacks. Pil Seung suspects her identity. Jin Dan tries to sabotage their interactions.

Episodes.Title: Identity Test
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung tests Ji Young with familiar places. Jin Dan plants false evidence about Ji Young's past.

Episodes.Title: Familiar Song
Episodes.Description: A childhood song triggers Ji Young's memories. Jin Dan hires someone to erase evidence of Do Ra's accident.

Episodes.Title: Photograph Evidence
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung finds a photo proving Ji Young is Do Ra. Jin Dan frames Ji Young for plagiarism.

Episodes.Title: Memory Return
Episodes.Description: Ji Young regains full memory as Do Ra. She confronts Jin Dan about the accident.

Episodes.Title: Revenge Plan
