Episodes.Description: A stowaway boy tries to redirect Terra Venture back to Earth. Meanwhile, Furio launches an attack, forcing the Rangers to protect the colony.

Episodes.Title: The Lights of Orion
Episodes.Description: Furio sends a monster impersonating Mike to trick Leo into revealing the location of the Lights of Orion, a legendary power source.

Episodes.Title: Double Duty
Episodes.Description: Kendrix meets an actress who looks identical to her. When the actress feigns injury, Kendrix takes her place on a film set, only to battle a monster seeking the Lights of Orion.

Episodes.Title: The Blue Crush
Episodes.Description: Kai develops a crush on Commander Stanton's daughter while rollerblading, but romance takes a backseat when a monster attacks Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: The Magna Defender
Episodes.Description: Leo battles Furio, who self-destructs after being defeated. Leo is saved by the mysterious Magna Defender, who emerges from a cave holding him.

Episodes.Title: The Sunflower Search
Episodes.Description: A monster believes the Lights of Orion are hidden in a sunflower statue. The Magna Defender reveals his tragic past and motive for vengeance against Scorpius.

Episodes.Title: Silent Sleep
Episodes.Description: A monster freezes Terra Venture's population to search for the Lights of Orion. Only Leo (protected by Mike's dog tags) and the Magna Defender remain unfrozen.

Episodes.Title: Orion Rising
Episodes.Description: Kendrix and Maya argue but must unite when a monster traps part of Terra Venture in a force field, seeking the Lights of Orion undisturbed.

Episodes.Title: Orion Returns
Episodes.Description: The Rangers, Scorpius, and Treacheron race to claim the Lights of Orion. The Scorpion Stinger damages the Astro Megaship, forcing the Rangers to pursue the Lights in Jet Jammers.

Episodes.Title: Shark Attack
Episodes.Description: Treacheron is framed as a traitor. Freed by the Shark brothers, he invades Terra Venture to capture Trakeena for revenge against Scorpius.

Episodes.Title: Redemption Day
Episodes.Description: The damaged Scorpion Stinger attempts to steal fuel from Terra Venture. The Magna Defender exploits this by destabilizing a volcano, endangering the colony for his vengeance.

Episodes.Title: Destined for Greatness
Episodes.Description: Skelecron captures four Rangers to power his warriors. Leo and Mike free them, with Mike embracing his destiny as the new Magna Defender to save the Galaxy Megazord.

Episodes.Title: Stolen Beauty
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sends a monster to steal beauty from Terra Venture's women. Disguised as a civilian, she tries to poison Mike, but he outwits her and reverses the theft.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue Mission
Episodes.Description: Mike leads a team to investigate a derelict ship, where a spider monster captures the crew. He and Leo free them, retrieving a mysterious book before the ship explodes.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Galactabeasts (1)
Episodes.Description: Deviot arrives with three powerful Zords (Stratoforce, Centaurus, Zenith) to attack Terra Venture. The Galactabeasts refuse to fight, forcing the Rangers to seek answers in the Galaxy Book.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Galactabeasts (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers decode the Galaxy Book to free the Galactabeasts from Deviot's control. They unite to defeat Deviot's Zords and protect Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: Heir to the Throne
Episodes.Description: Trakeena escapes planet Onyx after Deviot orchestrates Scorpius' death. She assumes command of his army, preventing Deviot from using her transformation cocoon.

Episodes.Title: An Evil Game
Episodes.Description: Trakeena captures Leo to avenge her father. Their duel is interrupted when Deviot's assassins target Trakeena, allowing Leo to escape amid the chaos.

Episodes.Title: Memories of Mirinoi
Episodes.Description: Maya's friend Shondra appears on Terra Venture, but Kendrix suspects her. Maya discovers Shondra stealing the Galaxy Book, revealing her as one of Trakeena's monsters.

Episodes.Title: Green Courage
Episodes.Description: Trakeena takes High Commander Renier hostage, demanding a mechanic to fix the Scorpion Stinger. Damon volunteers, while Leo infiltrates the ship to rescue the Commander.

Episodes.Title: Blue to the Test
Episodes.Description: A monster mind-controls Commander Stanton into steering Terra Venture into a star. Kai disobeys orders to expose the plot and save the colony.

Episodes.Title: Mean Wheels Mantis
Episodes.Description: A motorcycle-riding monster kidnaps Maya and Kendrix. The Rangers race to rescue them, with Leo upgrading his bike to the Capsular Cycle to win.

Episodes.Title: Loyax's Last Battle
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sends the fallen hero Loyax to Terra Venture for a final battle. Maya convinces him to redeem himself, but Deviot destroys him.

Episodes.Title: A Red Romance
Episodes.Description: Leo pursues a romance with Hannah, whose overprotective brother complicates matters. When a monster abducts Hannah, Leo must save her and defeat the threat.

Episodes.Title: The Chameliac Warrior
Episodes.Description: Trakeena hires Chameliac, a warrior who copies opponents' fighting styles. The Rangers defeat him by unpredictably switching tactics.

Episodes.Title: To the Tenth Power
Episodes.Description: Deviot revives the Psycho Rangers. The Space Rangers arrive to help the Galaxy Rangers combat these deadly foes in a high-stakes battle.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Pink
Episodes.Description: Psycho Pink uses the Savage Sword against Cassie (Pink Space Ranger). Kendrix sacrifices herself to destroy the sword, dying in the process. Karone (Andros' sister) is chosen as the new Pink Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Protect the Quasar Saber
Episodes.Description: Karone, disguised as Astronema, steals the Pink Quasar Saber from an auction on Onyx. She delivers it to the Rangers, officially joining them as the new Pink Galaxy Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Past
Episodes.Description: Karone helps Leo regain his powers after the Magnetox monster drains them. Confronted by visions of her evil past as Astronema, she overcomes her guilt and obtains a key that restores Leo's abilities with enhanced armor.

Episodes.Title: Turn Up the Volume
Episodes.Description: Damon competes for chief mechanic against rival Baxter, who steals his plans. They must team up to defeat a monster attacking Terra Venture's systems.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Lost Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Deviot reads forbidden words from the Galaxy Book, transporting Terra Venture into the mysterious Lost Galaxy. The Rangers confront space pirates led by Captain Mutiny.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Mutiny
Episodes.Description: Captain Mutiny and Deviot enslave Terra Venture's citizens to mine for 'Earth.' The Rangers battle Mutiny's forces to free the colony.

Episodes.Title: Grunchor on the Loose
Episodes.Description: The colossal monster Grunchor burrows into Terra Venture. The Rangers must evacuate citizens and defeat it before it destroys the colony.

Episodes.Title: Until Sunset
Episodes.Description: Leo and Damon are captured by Deviot, reminiscing about past adventures. The other Rangers race to rescue them before Mutiny's deadline.

Episodes.Title: Dream Battle
Episodes.Description: Hexuba uses magic to trap the Rangers in nightmares. They must conquer their fears to wake up and save Terra Venture. (No stream link available)

Episodes.Title: Hexuba's Graveyard
Episodes.Description: Hexuba resurrects defeated monsters to attack the Rangers. The team fights their past foes in a climactic showdown.

Episodes.Title: Raise the Titanisaur
Episodes.Description: Captain Mutiny unleashes the Titanisaur, a gargantuan monster. The Rangers deploy all Zords in a desperate battle to protect Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: Escape the Lost Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Mike sacrifices his Magna Defender powers to hold open a portal for Terra Venture's escape. Deviot betrays Mutiny and returns to Trakeena.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (1)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena fuses with Deviot in Scorpius' cocoon, becoming a powerful insectoid monster. She cripples Terra Venture, forcing the evacuation to a nearby planet.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (2)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sets Terra Venture's wreckage on a collision course with a planet. The Rangers destroy her ship using the Astro Megaship's self-destruct, stranding Leo on a moon.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (3)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena attacks Leo in Terra Venture's wreckage. Using his Battlizer armor, Leo defeats her but nearly dies. The Galactabeasts guide the colony to safety on Mirinoi, restoring its petrified people and reviving Kendrix.

Episodes.Title: Force from the Future (1)
Episodes.Description: In 3000 AD, mutant criminal Ransik escapes captivity, killing Red Ranger Alex Drake. Alex's team pursues him to 2001, where they recruit his ancestor Wes Collins to unlock their morphers.

Episodes.Title: Force from the Future (2)
Episodes.Description: Wes reluctantly uses Alex's morpher to help the Rangers battle Ransik. Though initially dismissed by Jen, he proves his worth during a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Something to Fight For
Episodes.Description: Wes questions his privileged life after Jen challenges his motivations. He earns the right to become the permanent Red Ranger by helping defeat a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Ransik Lives
Episodes.Description: Wes offers the Rangers shelter in his father's clock tower. During a painting job, Ransik takes Wes hostage and reveals the discrimination mutants face in the future.

Episodes.Title: A Blue Streak
Episodes.Description: Lucas must get a 2001 driver's license after being cited for speeding. A mutant challenges him to a high-speed chase during his driving test.

Episodes.Title: A Parting of Ways
Episodes.Description: Wes defies his father to rescue children held hostage by mutants. After publicly exposing his father's lack of charity, Wes moves into the clock tower.

Episodes.Title: Short-Circuited
Episodes.Description: Nadira kidnaps Circuit to prevent Megazord summoning. Trip must use his psychic powers against orders to locate their robotic ally during a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Jen's Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jen makes a dangerous deal with mutant Fat Catfish to locate Ransik, seeking personal vengeance for Alex's death.

Episodes.Title: The Time Shadow
Episodes.Description: When Bio-Lab's tank and the Megazord fail against a mutant, a mysterious ally from the future sends the Time Shadow zord.

Episodes.Title: Future Unknown
Episodes.Description: Ransik's actions alter the future, making Katie question their mission. Each Ranger must find personal motivation to stop Frax's new mutant.

Episodes.Title: Uniquely Trip
Episodes.Description: Trip loses confidence in his abilities and tries to imitate his teammates, learning to embrace his unique strengths instead.

Episodes.Title: Worlds Apart
Episodes.Description: Mr. Collins publicly shames Wes for working menial jobs. The Silver Guardians impress the Rangers during a Cyclobot attack, leading Eric to discover Wes is a Ranger.

Episodes.Title: The Quantum Quest
Episodes.Description: Ransik seeks the Quantum Controller uncovered by archaeologists. A rogue Silver Guardian activates it, becoming the Quantum Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Clash for Control (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik sends Commandcom to steal the Quantum Rex zord. Eric refuses to surrender the Quantum Morpher and pursues the thief through time with Wes.

Episodes.Title: Clash for Control (2)
Episodes.Description: The Quantum Rex rampages through Silver Hills. Mr. Collins offers the Time Force Rangers positions in the Silver Guardians while Wes tries to reason with Eric.

Episodes.Title: Bodyguard in Blue
Episodes.Description: Dr. Zaskin is kidnapped by Nadira. His daughter Holly hires Lucas as a bodyguard, forcing him to reveal his Ranger identity while protecting her from mutants.

Episodes.Title: The Legend of the Clock Tower
Episodes.Description: Katie experiences a time-displaced adventure involving the clock tower's ghostly legend while the Rangers repair its mechanism.

Episodes.Title: Trust and Triumph
Episodes.Description: Jen's distrust of Wes allows Nadira to escape. Trapped in another dimension, they must learn teamwork to rescue their teammates.

Episodes.Title: Trip Takes a Stand
Episodes.Description: Trip befriends gentle mutant Notacon, who is forcibly weaponized by Frax. He must protect Notacon from Eric's destructive intentions.

Episodes.Title: Quantum Secrets
Episodes.Description: Eric is captured by mutant Conwing, who steals his morpher and controls the Q-Rex. Eric discovers the morpher's origin with help from the future.

Episodes.Title: Lovestruck Rangers
Episodes.Description: Male Rangers clash over attraction to Angelique. Jen discovers Angelique is a mutant controlling the team, forcing her and Katie to free them.

Episodes.Title: The Last Race
Episodes.Description: Nadira releases racer mutant Dash, who challenges Lucas to a high-stakes race. Dash plans to honor their agreement, but Nadira interferes.

Episodes.Title: Full Exposure
Episodes.Description: A tabloid photographer hires Katie to help photograph Rangers unmasked. She must warn the team while protecting their identities.

Episodes.Title: Movie Madness (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik traps the Rangers in film genres. They battle movie-themed monsters while navigating classic cinema tropes.

Episodes.Title: Movie Madness (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers continue fighting through movie dimensions to escape Ransik's cinematic prison and return to reality.

Episodes.Title: Time Force Traitor
Episodes.Description: The Rangers suspect a traitor when Ransik anticipates their strategies. Internal distrust threatens to fracture the team.

Episodes.Title: Frax's Fury
Episodes.Description: Frax rebels against Ransik after constant humiliation. He creates powerful monsters to destroy both Ransik and the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of Destiny
Episodes.Description: Ransik forces Dr. Zaskin to create a cure for his mutation. The Rangers confront Ransik during his transformation crisis.

Episodes.Title: Fight Against Fate
Episodes.Description: Ransik learns of his future defeat. He attempts to change destiny by eliminating the Rangers before they can fulfill their roles.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Defeated
Episodes.Description: The Rangers seemingly defeat Ransik, altering the future. They face consequences for changing history while returning to 3000 AD.

Episodes.Title: Undercover Rangers
Episodes.Description: The Rangers go undercover at Silver Guardians headquarters to investigate suspicious activities, testing Eric's loyalty.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Knight
Episodes.Description: A medieval-themed mutant creates chaos. The Rangers must combat ancient weaponry while protecting historical reenactors.

Episodes.Title: Time for Lightspeed
Episodes.Description: The Time Force Rangers team up with the Lightspeed Rescue Rangers to combat a joint threat from Ransik and demon queen Olympius.

Episodes.Title: Reflections of Evil
Episodes.Description: A mirror-themed mutant creates evil duplicates of the Rangers. The team must confront their darker selves to prevail.

Episodes.Title: Nadira's Dream Date
Episodes.Description: Nadira kidnaps a celebrity for a dream date. The Rangers must rescue him while navigating her unpredictable powers.

Episodes.Title: Circuit Unsure
Episodes.Description: Circuit malfunctions during a critical battle, forcing Trip to repair him mid-fight while the Rangers face Ransik's new monster.

Episodes.Title: A Calm Before the Storm
Episodes.Description: Ransik prepares his final assault as the Rangers strengthen alliances. Tensions rise before the climactic battle.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik launches an all-out attack on Silver Hills. The Rangers make their final stand as the city descends into chaos.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (2)
Episodes.Description: Ransik critically injures Jen. Wes and Eric pursue him through time as the remaining Rangers protect Silver Hills.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (3)
Episodes.Description: Wes confronts Ransik in 3000 AD. Nadira's redemption and Ransik's surrender conclude the battle, with the Rangers choosing their futures.

Episodes.Title: Lionheart
Episodes.Description: Cole Evans joins four Power Rangers on the Animarium to battle Orgs after discovering his red lion crystal. The team forms the Wild Force Megazord for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Darkness Awakening
Episodes.Description: Master Org resurfaces as the Rangers learn to combine their Wild Zords into the Megazord. Cole attempts to reason with the heartless Orgs.

Episodes.Title: Click, Click, Zoom
Episodes.Description: Camera Org turns citizens invisible. Cole defies Taylor's leadership rules to rescue the team, leading to a reconciliation.

Episodes.Title: Never Give Up!
Episodes.Description: Max is captured by Bell Org after Danny neglects teamwork. Danny overcomes his fear of heights to rescue Max.

Episodes.Title: Ancient Awakening
Episodes.Description: Alyssa discovers an ancient emblem in a cave, leading to the summoning of the Elephant Zord to defeat Tire Org.

Episodes.Title: Wishes on the Water
Episodes.Description: Max tosses a wish into Turtle Cove lake, but Ship Org emerges with the bottle. The Giraffe Zord helps defeat the Org.

Episodes.Title: The Bear Necessities
Episodes.Description: Taylor discovers twin boys who transform into Bear Zords to help defeat Cell Phone Org and restore morphing abilities.

Episodes.Title: Soul Searching
Episodes.Description: Cole searches for the Soul Bird to heal the injured Red Lion Zord, encountering Master Org who recognizes Cole's family photo.

Episodes.Title: Soul Bird Salvation
Episodes.Description: Retinax freezes the Zords, but a hatched Soul Bird restores their powers, enabling the Rangers to defeat the Duke Org.

Episodes.Title: Curse of the Wolf
Episodes.Description: Nayzor releases Zen-Aku, who defeats the Rangers and steals the Elephant power orb using dark magic.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Zords
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku summons Dark Wild Zords after saving Alyssa from Toxica and Jindrax, escalating the conflict.

Episodes.Title: Predazord, Awaken
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku combines Dark Zords into the Predazord, stealing the Giraffe Power Animal from the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of Zen-Aku
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku kidnaps Princess Shayla and frees Motorcycle Org. Shayla's necklace triggers his suppressed memories.

Episodes.Title: Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Nayzor manipulates Zen-Aku into believing he is pure evil, intensifying his attacks on the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: The Ancient Warrior
Episodes.Description: Animus reveals Zen-Aku's true identity as Merrick, an ancient warrior cursed by the Org mask.

Episodes.Title: The Lone Wolf
Episodes.Description: Merrick battles Quadra Org alone to retrieve stolen Animal Crystals, regaining his Lunar Wolf Ranger powers.

Episodes.Title: Power Play
Episodes.Description: Toxica becomes General Org Necronomica. Merrick helps defeat her using his Wolf Savage Cycle.

Episodes.Title: Secrets and Lies
Episodes.Description: Signal Org erases Cole's memory. Alyssa discovers Cole's parents are presumed dead.

Episodes.Title: The Tornado Spin
Episodes.Description: Max learns a bowling technique called the Tornado Spin to defeat Bowling Org, reviving his mentor's spirit.

Episodes.Title: Three's a Crowd
Episodes.Description: Danny competes for Kendall's affection while battling Wedding Dress Org, revealing his identity as the Black Ranger.

Episodes.Title: A Father's Footsteps
Episodes.Description: Alyssa uses her father's martial arts training to defeat Samurai Org and protect Turtle Cove.

Episodes.Title: Sing Song
Episodes.Description: Shayla and Merrick sing to awaken the Deer Zord, helping the Rangers defeat Tombstone Org.

Episodes.Title: The Wings of Animaria
Episodes.Description: Cole uses the Falcon Summoner to defeat the resurrected Nayzor, forming the Isis Megazord.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcements from the Future, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Time Force Rangers Wes and Eric arrive in Turtle Cove, teaming with Wild Force to battle Mut-Orgs.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcements from the Future, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Ransik destroys the Mut-Orgs' mutant halves, allowing 12 Rangers to defeat the hybrids in a joint battle.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Last Stand
Episodes.Description: Master Org kidnaps four Rangers and reveals his origin to Cole. Toxica and Jindrax find new leadership in Mandilok.

Episodes.Title: Unfinished Business
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku returns to merge with Merrick, who must accept his friends' help to defeat his past darkness.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Cole befriends a boy named Kite, who helps defeat Mandilok's Duke Orgs Artilla and Helicos.

Episodes.Title: The Flute
Episodes.Description: Flute Org forces citizens to dance uncontrollably. Animus intervenes to save the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Team Carnival
Episodes.Description: Jindrax teams with his brother Juggelo to destroy the Rangers at an amusement park, leading to Juggelo's demise.

Episodes.Title: Taming of the Zords
Episodes.Description: Lion Tamer Org controls the Wild Zords. Kite frees them using mysterious powers.

Episodes.Title: Monitoring Earth
Episodes.Description: Mandilok turns Kite against humanity. Kite reveals himself as Animus and removes the Wild Zords.

Episodes.Title: The Soul of Humanity
Episodes.Description: The Rangers battle Toy Org without Zords. Animus restores their powers after witnessing human courage.

Episodes.Title: Forever Red
Episodes.Description: Cole teams with nine previous Red Rangers to stop the Machine Empire from reactivating Serpentera on the moon.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Herald, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Duke Org Onikage infiltrates the Animarium, kidnaps Princess Shayla, and creates Shadow Rangers.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Herald, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Onikage is destroyed by the Pegasus Megazord, but Master Org escapes with Princess Shayla.

Episodes.Title: Fishing for a Friend
Episodes.Description: Jindrax manipulates Rangers and Locomotive Org to re-energize Toxica's horn, reviving her from the spirit world.

Episodes.Title: Sealing the Nexus
Episodes.Description: Rangers battle resurrected Org Generals to disable the Nexus forcefield, enabling Toxica and Jindrax to rescue Shayla.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Power Rangers, Part 1
Episodes.Description: With villains seemingly defeated, the Rangers prepare to disband. Master Org returns as a new threat emerges.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Power Rangers, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Master Org's final assault forces the Rangers into a last battle for Earth and the Animarium.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Jungle (1)
Episodes.Description: Casey Rhodes, Lily Chilman, and Theo Martin are chosen as guardians of the imprisoned Dai Shi. When the arrogant Jarrod accidentally releases Dai Shi, the trio seeks their new master, RJ, at Jungle Karma Pizza.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Jungle (2)
Episodes.Description: The new Rangers adjust to their roles under RJ's guidance while battling Camille and Rinshi warriors flooding Ocean Bluff.

Episodes.Title: Sigh of the Tiger
Episodes.Description: Casey questions RJ's training methods while Buffalord attacks. Fran defends Jungle Karma Pizza from a chaotic birthday party.

Episodes.Title: A Taste of Poison
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi reveals himself in Jarrod's body and deploys the Five Fingers of Poison. Lily battles Rantipede after a nightmare about Jarrod.

Episodes.Title: Can't Win Them All
Episodes.Description: Theo's confidence shatters after losing to Gakko. RJ trains him to regain his skills while Casey and Lily protect the city alone.

Episodes.Title: Dance the Night Away
Episodes.Description: Tension between Theo and Casey escalates when Lily befriends Casey. Stingerella and Toady use dance rhythms to overpower the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Pizza Slice of Life
Episodes.Description: RJ leaves Casey in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza, leading to chaos. Camille confronts Naja's plot to overthrow Dai Shi.

Episodes.Title: Way of the Master
Episodes.Description: Lily seeks the Jungle Mace from retired Master Phant to defeat Pangolin. Dai Shi prepares to resurrect the Sky Overlord.

Episodes.Title: Good Karma, Bad Karma
Episodes.Description: Casey's $5 tip is stolen by a boy named Josh. Carnisoar erases Jarrod's past good deeds to strengthen Dai Shi's control.

Episodes.Title: Blind Leading the Blind
Episodes.Description: Theo trains with blind Master Swoop to master Bat Spirit techniques. The Rangers battle Carnisoar's aerial warriors Bai Lai and Carden.

Episodes.Title: Pushed to the Edge
Episodes.Description: Camille seeks Lily's advice after Carnisoar's harsh training of Jarrod. She summons Sea Overlord Jellica, who trains Dai Shi instead.

Episodes.Title: One Master Too Many
Episodes.Description: RJ feels sidelined when Casey's second master, Shark technique expert Master Finn (RJ's father), arrives. Jellica unleashes Crustaceo.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance (1)
Episodes.Description: Overconfident Rangers are defeated by Dai Shi. RJ sacrifices himself to spare them, leaving them masterless.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers enter the spirit world to rescue RJ and confront childhood fears. Fran discovers their secret identities.

Episodes.Title: Bad to the Bone
Episodes.Description: Lily's kindness backfires when Porcupongo's quill makes her rude. Fran helps her regain her true self.

Episodes.Title: Friends Don't Fade Away
Episodes.Description: RJ struggles with controlling his Wolf spirit after battling Dai Shi, becoming a threat to others. He learns to rely on friends.

Episodes.Title: No 'I' in Leader
Episodes.Description: RJ reassures Casey of his leadership role after joining as the Wolf Ranger. Grizzaka rebels against Dai Shi's command.

Episodes.Title: True Friends, True Spirits
Episodes.Description: RJ saves Flit from Grizzaka's curse, restoring harmony with his animal spirit. Flit becomes an ally.

Episodes.Title: Path of the Rhino
Episodes.Description: Dominic joins the Rangers as the Rhino Ranger after learning their identities, fulfilling his destiny from Master Mao.

Episodes.Title: Dash for the Dagger
Episodes.Description: Jarrod finds the Rhino Nexus and seeks the Control Dagger. Dominic races to protect it, but Camille delivers it to Dai Shi.

Episodes.Title: Race to the Nexus
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi, the Rangers, and the Overlords clash over the Rhino Nexus. Dominic unlocks its power with his friends' help.

Episodes.Title: Arise the Crystal Eyes
Episodes.Description: The Rangers protect the Crystal Eyes from Dai Shi and the Overlords, which can resurrect the Phantom Beasts.

Episodes.Title: Fear and the Phantoms
Episodes.Description: The Phantom Beasts return and capture three masters to create the Spirit Rangers—evil counterparts to the Jungle Fury team.

Episodes.Title: Blue Ranger, Twin Danger
Episodes.Description: RJ devises a plan to stop the Spirit Rangers. He risks everything to save his father and the other masters from evil control.

Episodes.Title: One Last Second Chance
Episodes.Description: Camille hosts a twisted game show testing the Rangers' knowledge of past events. Wrong answers risk 'cancellation'.

Episodes.Title: Don't Blow That Dough
Episodes.Description: Whiger steals Casey's Tiger Spirit, weakening him. Dai Shi becomes the Phantom Beast King and promotes Camille.

Episodes.Title: Tigers Fall, Lions Rise
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi strips Whiger of power for failing to kill Casey. Casey shows kindness, making Whiger reconsider his allegiance.

Episodes.Title: The Spirit of Kindness
Episodes.Description: Camille steals a cloning formula from Maryl to duplicate monkeys. Scorch and Snapper plot against her out of jealousy.

Episodes.Title: Maryl and the Monkeys
Episodes.Description: Camille's monkey cloning plan backfires. Scorch and Snapper sabotage her, exposing their jealousy of Dai Shi's favoritism.

Episodes.Title: To Earn Your Stripes
Episodes.Description: Casey trains to regain his Tiger Spirit. Jarrod's humanity resurfaces, weakening Dai Shi's control as the final battle looms.

Episodes.Title: Path of the Righteous
Episodes.Description: Jarrod breaks free from Dai Shi with Camille's help. They join the Rangers for the ultimate showdown against the Phantom Beasts.

Episodes.Title: Now the Final Fury
Episodes.Description: The Rangers and allies unleash their animal spirits to defeat Dai Shi. Jarrod and Camille redeem themselves in an epic conclusion.

Episodes.Title: The Road to Corinth
Episodes.Description: As humanity retreats into Corinth, mysterious drifter Dillon arrives with Ziggy. The Rangers defend the city against Venjix's Attack Bot.

Episodes.Title: Fade to Black
Episodes.Description: Dillon is discovered to have Venjix tech inside him. The Rangers recruit him for Series Black after he protects Ziggy.

Episodes.Title: Rain
Episodes.Description: Dillon accepts the Black Ranger role on one condition: Ziggy's release from prison.

Episodes.Title: Go for the Green
Episodes.Description: Ziggy bonds with the Green Morpher to prevent Tenaya 7 from stealing it.

Episodes.Title: Handshake
Episodes.Description: Dillon masters his invincibility shield while Tenaya infiltrates Corinth. Doctor K's identity is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Ranger Green
Episodes.Description: Ziggy trains his teleportation ability while confronting his criminal past.

Episodes.Title: Ranger Red
Episodes.Description: Scott retrieves a critical part from his brother's plane wreckage to repair the Croc Carrier Zord.

Episodes.Title: Ranger Yellow (1)
Episodes.Description: Summer confronts her past as a socialite when Tenaya attacks during a school visit.

Episodes.Title: Ranger Yellow (2)
Episodes.Description: Summer's parents pressure her into marriage for financial security.

Episodes.Title: Ranger Blue
Episodes.Description: Flynn reflects on his journey to becoming the Blue Ranger after a power malfunction sidelines him.

Episodes.Title: Doctor K
Episodes.Description: Haunted by her past at Alphabet Soup, Doctor K confronts her role in creating Venjix.

Episodes.Title: Blitz
Episodes.Description: Dillon chooses to preserve his new memories over recovering his past when Venjix attacks with multiple monsters.

Episodes.Title: Brother's Keeper

Entries.Title: Prehistoric Park
Entries.Description: Wildlife expert Nigel Marven travels through time via a portal to rescue extinct creatures from Earth's prehistoric past, bringing them to a modern-day wildlife sanctuary where they are cared for alongside present-day animals. Using CGI, the series blends science and speculation to showcase species like Tyrannosaurus rex, woolly mammoths, and giant insects.

Episodes.Title: T-Rex Returns
Episodes.Description: Nigel ventures to Late Cretaceous Montana (65 million years ago) to rescue a Tyrannosaurus rex. After encountering a Triceratops (named Theo) and witnessing a T. rex battle, he saves two juvenile T. rex (Terence and Matilda) moments before the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs [citation:5][citation:6][citation:9].

Episodes.Title: A Mammoth Undertaking
Episodes.Description: Nigel travels to Siberia 10,000 years ago to rescue a woolly mammoth named Martha from extinction. He faces challenges including a cave bear and injured mammoths, while in the park, Martha is introduced to a herd of African elephants in the specialized 'Mammoth Mount' enclosure [citation:6][citation:9][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: DinoBirds
Episodes.Description: Nigel visits Cretaceous China (125 million years ago) to rescue Microraptors – feathered dinosaurs that support the theory that birds evolved from dinosaurs. This urgent mission occurs just before a volcanic eruption wipes out the local fauna [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Saving the Sabre Tooth
Episodes.Description: Nigel and big cat specialist Saba Douglas-Hamilton travel to South America 1 million years ago to rescue the giant saber-toothed cat Smilodon. Nigel speculates that overspecialization contributed to their extinction. The rescued cats are housed in the 'Big Cat Climb' enclosure [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: The Bug House
Episodes.Description: Nigel travels to the Upper Carboniferous period (300 million years ago) to rescue giant arthropods including Meganeura (giant dragonfly), Arthropleura (giant millipede), and Pulmonoscorpius (giant scorpion). These creatures are housed in a specialized high-oxygen enclosure called 'The Bug House' [citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Giant Croc
Episodes.Description: Nigel journeys to the Late Cretaceous (75 million years ago) to capture Deinosuchus, a 9-ton crocodilian relative of alligators. The mission is perilous, with concerns that Nigel 'may have bitten off more than he can chew.' The creature is housed in 'Deinosuchus Dip' [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Making of Prehistoric Park
Episodes.Description: Behind-the-scenes featurette exploring the production and CGI techniques used to create the series.

The Village of the Fighting Fish (Part 2)

Entries.Title: Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2199
Entries.Description: In 2199, Earth faces extinction from Gamilon radiation. Queen Starsha of Iscandar offers salvation via the Cosmo DNA device. Humanity rebuilds the WWII battleship Yamato into the starship Argo, sending its crew on a perilous 148,000-light-year mission to save Earth.

Episodes.Title: Messenger of Iscandar
Episodes.Description: In 2199, Earth's fleet battles Gamilon at Pluto. Cadets Derek Wildstar and Mark Venture retrieve a message capsule from Mars containing hope for humanity—and tragic news about Wildstar's brother.

Episodes.Title: Toward a Sea of Stars
Episodes.Description: Earth completes the interstellar warship Yamato, hidden under the ruins of its WWII namesake. Gamilon attacks during its maiden launch, forcing Captain Avatar to activate defenses prematurely.

Episodes.Title: Escape from the Jupiter Sphere
Episodes.Description: A warp malfunction strands the Yamato on a floating continent in Jupiter's atmosphere. The crew repairs the ship while fending off Gamilon forces.

Episodes.Title: Gravestone on a Frozen Field
Episodes.Description: The Yamato lands on Saturn's moon Titan for repairs. Wildstar discovers his brother's crashed ship, the Paladin, and accepts his death.

Episodes.Title: The Trap on All Sides
Episodes.Description: Colonel Ganz lures the Yamato to Pluto using planet bombs. The Reflex Gun cripples the ship, forcing Wildstar to lead a strike team to destroy it.

Episodes.Title: The Sun Sets on Pluto
Episodes.Description: Wildstar's team locates the Reflex Gun. The Yamato destroys Pluto's Gamilon base, ending the bombardment of Earth.

Episodes.Title: Farewell to the Solar System
Episodes.Description: As the Yamato exits the solar system, crew members send final messages to loved ones on Earth. Wildstar and Avatar confront personal losses.

Episodes.Title: Wish Upon a Star
Episodes.Description: Pursued by Gamilons, the Yamato navigates solar flares near a star. Desslok deploys energy-draining gas to trap the ship.

Episodes.Title: Clockwork Prisoner
Episodes.Description: The crew rebuilds a Gamilon android found on Saturn's moon. IQ-9 befriends it, revealing shared AI sentience.

Episodes.Title: Graveyard of the Universe
Episodes.Description: Trapped in a dimensional rift with a Gamilon ship, the Yamato brokers a ceasefire to escape. Mutual distrust threatens the truce.

Episodes.Title: A World I Once Saw
Episodes.Description: A captured Gamilon pilot reveals the truth behind Earth's first contact. Wildstar recalls his parents' deaths in a Gamilon attack.

Episodes.Title: What Lies Beyond
Episodes.Description: An extradimensional vessel attacks near the Milky Way's edge. Sandor discovers a link between the entity and Wave Motion energy.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf from Another Dimension
Episodes.Description: The Yamato shelters in an asteroid cluster, uncovering Gamilon tactics. General Domel plots an ambush using spatial anomalies.

Episodes.Title: The Whisper of the Witch
Episodes.Description: Kodai and Yuki return to an eerily empty Yamato. A memory-manipulating foe obstructs efforts to locate the crew.

Episodes.Title: Point of No Return
Episodes.Description: General Domel prepares a massive ambush. Unbeknownst to him, political turmoil brews on Gamilon.

Episodes.Title: A Choice for the Future
Episodes.Description: Discovery of a habitable planet sparks a mutiny. Some crew members advocate abandoning Earth to colonize the new world.

Episodes.Title: Out of the Forest of Memory
Episodes.Description: An ancient warp gate offers a shortcut. Engineer Sanada reveals secrets about the Yamato's navigation system.

Episodes.Title: Over the Black Light
Episodes.Description: The Yamato warps past planet Balun, facing a massive Gamilon fleet. A high-stakes battle ensues in the Large Magellanic Cloud.

Episodes.Title: They're Coming!
Episodes.Description: Okita navigates a lethal nebula to outmaneuver Gamilons. General Domel reinstated, pursues relentlessly.

Episodes.Title: Under a Rainbow Sun
Episodes.Description: Domel's ambush unfolds at the Rainbow Galaxy. A drill missile disables the Wave Motion Gun, forcing Sandor and IQ-9 into a race against time.

Episodes.Title: Prison Planet 17
Episodes.Description: Yuki is captured and taken to Gamilon's prison planet Leptapoda. Kodai scouts the same planet for supplies, sparking a rescue mission.

Episodes.Title: The Planet That We Head For
Episodes.Description: Iscandar and Gamilas are revealed as twin planets. The Yamato warps into enemy territory for a final approach.

Episodes.Title: One Man's War
Episodes.Description: With Gamilon possessing a Wave Motion Gun, the Yamato assaults their capital. Kodai rescues Yuki amidst chaos.

Episodes.Title: The Distant Promised Land
Episodes.Description: After defeating Desslok, the Yamato lands on Iscandar. Starsha grants the Cosmo Reverser, and Kodai learns his brother's fate.

Episodes.Title: The Forever War
Episodes.Description: En route to Earth, Desslok ambushes the Yamato for a final battle. The crew must deliver the Cosmo DNA or humanity perishes.

Episodes.Title: Earth, We're Home
Episodes.Description: The Yamato returns with seconds to spare. The Cosmo DNA restores Earth, but Captain Avatar sacrifices himself to ensure victory.

Episodes.Title: The Comet Empire
Episodes.Description: One year after saving Earth, a new threat emerges: Prince Zordar's Comet Empire. Derek Wildstar commands the Argo against Desslok's vengeful alliance with Zordar.

Entries.Title: Godzilla (1978 Animated Series)
Entries.Description: Produced by Hanna-Barbera, this series follows the adventures of Godzilla, his nephew Godzooky, and the crew of the research ship Calico. Godzilla becomes their protector after they rescue Godzooky from a coral reef. Each episode features battles against monstrous threats.

Entries.Title: The Scooby-Doo Show
Entries.Description: Scooby-Doo and friends solve supernatural mysteries while traveling in the Mystery Machine, encountering ghosts, monsters, and villains.

Entries.Title: Sabrina: The Animated Series
Entries.Description: A 12-year-old Sabrina Spellman navigates middle school while learning witchcraft from her aunts Hilda and Zelda. Each episode follows her magical misadventures, often involving her cat Salem, best friend Chloe, and crush Harvey, teaching lessons about responsibility and honesty.

Episodes.Title: Most Dangerous Witch
Episodes.Description: Tim the Witch-Smeller captures Harvey, mistaking him for a witch. Sabrina must rescue him before he becomes a permanent trophy.

Episodes.Title: You Said a Mouse-Ful
Episodes.Description: Salem replaces Sabrina's science fair mouse but gets traded to NASA. Sabrina must save him before he becomes an astromouse.

Episodes.Title: Boogie Shoes
Episodes.Description: Harvey gets magical shoes that make him dance uncontrollably. Sabrina must remove them before he dances himself to exhaustion.

Episodes.Title: Tail of Two Kitties
Episodes.Description: Salem falls for a kitty-witch and must choose between staying a cat or becoming human again.

Episodes.Title: The Senses-Shattering Adventures of Captain Harvtastic
Episodes.Description: Harvey's wish transports him into his comic book world. Sabrina must help defeat the villain Dysphillia before they're erased from existence.

Episodes.Title: Witch Switch
Episodes.Description: Sabrina swaps lives with Gem, but Gem refuses to return her witch powers. Sabrina must trick her to switch back.

Episodes.Title: Picture Perfect
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Gem compete for Student of the Year. Sabrina uses magic to win but confesses her dishonesty during the award ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Field Trippin'
Episodes.Description: Sabrina babysits terror twins at a museum. When magic backfires, Harvey and the twins end up trapped in artwork.

Episodes.Title: No Time to Be a Hero
Episodes.Description: Sabrina time-travels to correct undeserved praise for saving Harvey, but her actions worsen the situation.

Episodes.Title: Extreme Harvey
Episodes.Description: Sabrina magically enhances Harvey's skateboarding skills, but the spell wears off during a championship contest.

Episodes.Title: Shrink to Fit
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Chloe shrink to fit fad jeans but continue shrinking. They must reverse the spell before disappearing.

Episodes.Title: Has Anybody Seen My Quigley?
Episodes.Description: Uncle Quigley runs away, leaving a strict nanny. The Spellmans turn her into a hippie but regret it and seek Quigley's return.

Episodes.Title: Wag the Witch
Episodes.Description: Sabrina runs for class president against Gem, using magic to appear 'normal' and hide her witch identity.

Episodes.Title: Witchy Grrrls
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's band uses magic for fame, but egos cause a split. They reunite after realizing they miss each other.

Episodes.Title: Paranormal Pi
Episodes.Description: Pi investigates paranormal activity after seeing Uncle Zamboni fly. Sabrina must prevent him from discovering her family's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Anywhere But Here
Episodes.Description: Sabrina magically becomes an adult but learns adulthood comes with burdensome responsibilities.

Episodes.Title: Nothin' Says Lovin' Like Something From a Coven
Episodes.Description: Sabrina throws a Halloween party and competes with Gem to host the best event.

Episodes.Title: Once Upon a Whine
Episodes.Description: Sabrina accidentally summons Cinderella to Greendale. When she tries to send her back, Harvey ends up in fairy-tale land.

Episodes.Title: Documagicary
Episodes.Description: A documentary crew invades Sabrina's life, but she quits after realizing fame isn't enjoyable. Tim the Witch-Smeller is released from prison.

Episodes.Title: The Grandparent Trap
Episodes.Description: Sabrina fears her grandparents are divorcing and schemes to reunite them, only to learn they plan to renew their vows.

Episodes.Title: I Got Glue Babe
Episodes.Description: Sabrina casts a spell to end her rivalry with Gem, but they become magically glued together.

Episodes.Title: Boy Meets Bike
Episodes.Description: Sabrina conjures a sentient bike for Harvey to beat a bully, but it becomes dangerously competitive.

Episodes.Title: Upside Down Town
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's magical upside-down cake reverses personalities. She must find an antidote before chaos spreads.

Episodes.Title: The Importance of Being Norma
Episodes.Description: Sabrina tries to impress cheerleaders while guiding her geeky friend Norma. A spell to make Norma 'cool' backfires.

Episodes.Title: Stage Fright
Episodes.Description: Sabrina conjures Romeo for a play, but he falls for Enchantra. Sabrina learns about true love.

Episodes.Title: Witchitis
Episodes.Description: Sabrina avoids a witchitis shot, but her germs grow into human-sized threats. She seeks help to save her friends.

Episodes.Title: My Stepmother the Babe
Episodes.Description: Sabrina turns her father's fiancée into a 12-year-old to relate to her, but her father disapproves.

Episodes.Title: Absence of Malissa
Episodes.Description: Sabrina attends Witches Boot Camp to gain full powers but struggles with the challenges.

Episodes.Title: This Is Your Nine Lives
Episodes.Description: Sabrina time-travels to find Salem a unique birthday gift and encounters a pirate.

Episodes.Title: Planet of the Dogs
Episodes.Description: A stray dog Alvin becomes a canine vigilante, kidnapping Sabrina's family.

Episodes.Title: Hex-Change Students
Episodes.Description: Two fairy exchange students visit Greendale, causing magical chaos.

Episodes.Title: Saturday Night Furor
Episodes.Description: Sabrina tries to have fun without Uncle Quigley's supervision but faces magical mishaps.

Episodes.Title: Scare Apparent
Episodes.Description: Sabrina helps Boogey Jr. overcome his fear of shadows, learning about facing fears.

Episodes.Title: The Hex Files
Episodes.Description: Sabrina visits Uncle Quigley's lab, uncovering mysterious experiments.

Episodes.Title: Stone Broke
Episodes.Description: Gem moves in with Sabrina after her parents lose their fortune, leading to comedic clashes.

Episodes.Title: Salem's Plot
Episodes.Description: Salem tries to disguise himself when a friend visits, embarrassed by his appearance.

Episodes.Title: Molar Molar
Episodes.Description: Sabrina uses magic to avoid wisdom teeth pain, but the spell backfires.

Episodes.Title: Harvzilla
Episodes.Description: Sabrina helps Harvey bulk up magically, but the transformation goes awry.

Episodes.Title: When in Rome
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Gem time-travel to ancient Rome for a book report, facing historical dangers.

Episodes.Title: Field of Screams
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Gem form a baseball team to battle monsters from the Netherworld.

Episodes.Title: Driver Ed
Episodes.Description: Sabrina helps Hilda pass her driver's test using magic, leading to chaotic results.

Episodes.Title: What Becomes of the Broken Hearted?
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is upset when her favorite teacher excludes her from a field trip.

Episodes.Title: Send in the Clones
Episodes.Description: Sabrina clones herself for an Extracurricular Activities Fair, but the clones cause chaos.

Episodes.Title: Feats of Clay
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets jealous when Harvey becomes obsessed with a martial arts hero.

Episodes.Title: Generation Zap
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Enchantra switch bodies, experiencing each other's lives for a day.

Episodes.Title: Board & Sorcery
Episodes.Description: Sabrina magically turns Harvey into a snowman while helping him snowboard.

Episodes.Title: Enchanted Vacation
Episodes.Description: The Spellmans vacation in the Netherworld while evading a witch trapper.

Episodes.Title: Moldy Oldie
Episodes.Description: Gandolf visits to renew his witching license, causing nostalgic chaos.

Episodes.Title: Xabrina, Warrior Witch
Episodes.Description: Harvey tests a virtual reality game designed to be addictive, trapping him in a digital world.

Episodes.Title: Straight Outta Paris
Episodes.Description: Sabrina accidentally brings the Eiffel Tower to life, causing an uproar in France.

Episodes.Title: Strange New World
Episodes.Description: Sabrina summons Thomas Edison for a science project, leading to historical chaos.

Episodes.Title: Witchery Science Theater
Episodes.Description: Sabrina transports her friends into a movie after botching a spell.

Episodes.Title: You've Got a Friend
Episodes.Description: Sabrina resurrects Harvey's imaginary childhood friend, causing nostalgic chaos.

Episodes.Title: Hexcalibur
Episodes.Description: Sabrina consults Merlin's journal for a Netherworld term paper, unleashing legendary magic.

Episodes.Title: Brina Baby
Episodes.Description: Sabrina vows to stop using magic but must reconsider when her family is threatened.

Episodes.Title: Witchwrecked
Episodes.Description: Sabrina shipwrecks her class on an island during a field trip, leading to survival challenges.

Episodes.Title: Fish Schtick
Episodes.Description: Sabrina accidentally transforms herself into a fish, leading to underwater adventures.

Episodes.Title: Witchmas Carole
Episodes.Description: Sabrina shows Gem the value of generosity during Christmas using magical interventions.

Episodes.Title: Truth or Scare
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and friends go camping with Uncle Quigley, encountering supernatural scares.

Episodes.Title: Generation Hex
Episodes.Description: Sabrina spends fundraiser money on herself, learning about responsibility and guilt.

Episodes.Title: Working Witches
Episodes.Description: Hilda and Zelda work at a fast-food joint to buy a car, facing mortal-world challenges.

Episodes.Title: Wiccan of the Sea
Episodes.Description: Sabrina transports herself, Chloe, and Salem to a beach to escape winter.

Episodes.Title: Key to My Heart
Episodes.Description: Sabrina becomes jealous of her piano instructor's girlfriend, leading to magical interference.

Episodes.Title: La Femme Sabrina
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Harvey are thrust into a spy adventure after a magical mishap.

Episodes.Title: The Bat Pack
Episodes.Description: Hilda's vampire friends, the Bat Pack, visit and dazzle Sabrina with their charm.

Entries.Title: The New Fantastic Four
Entries.Description: An animated series featuring Marvel's Fantastic Four superhero team. In this adaptation, the Human Torch is replaced by the robot H.E.R.B.I.E. as they battle villains like Doctor Doom and Magneto.

Episodes.Title: Monster Among Us
Episodes.Description: The Fantastic Four investigate mysterious monster attacks in New York City while facing public distrust.

Episodes.Title: The Menace of Magneto
Episodes.Description: Magneto hijacks a nuclear missile to hold the world hostage, forcing the Fantastic Four to intervene.

Episodes.Title: The Phantom of Film City
Episodes.Description: A movie director uses advanced technology to create real monsters that escape into the city.

Episodes.Title: Medusa and the Inhumans
Episodes.Description: The Inhumans seek the Fantastic Four's help when Maximus threatens their hidden city Attilan.

Episodes.Title: The Diamond of Doom
Episodes.Description: Mole Man steals a massive diamond to power his earthquake-generating weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Mole Man
Episodes.Description: Mole Man returns with a new plan to flood the surface world by melting polar ice caps.

Episodes.Title: The Olympics of Space
Episodes.Description: The team competes in an intergalactic competition that turns out to be a Skrull trap.

Episodes.Title: The Fantastic Four Meet Doctor Doom
Episodes.Description: Doctor Doom captures the team and forces them to fight in gladiatorial games.

Episodes.Title: The Frightful Four
Episodes.Description: Wizard forms a new supervillain team to destroy the Fantastic Four once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Calamity on the Campus
Episodes.Description: Mad Thinker uses a university campus to test his destructive android creations.

Episodes.Title: The Impossible Man
Episodes.Description: A mischievous alien from Poppup causes chaos in New York with his reality-bending powers.

Episodes.Title: The Final Victory of Doctor Doom
Episodes.Description: Doctor Doom attempts to swap bodies with Reed Richards to gain ultimate power.

Episodes.Title: Blastaar, the Living Bomb Burst
Episodes.Description: A powerful alien fugitive escapes the Negative Zone and threatens Earth with annihilation.

Entries.Description: Dr. Bruce Banner transforms into the monstrous Hulk when angered in this classic animated anthology series featuring Marvel Comics characters. Based on Stan Lee and Jack Kirby's Marvel Comics character.

Entries.Title: The Incredible Hulk
Entries.Description: Bruce Banner, a scientist exposed to gamma radiation, transforms into the monstrous Hulk when angered. While searching for a cure, he battles villains and protects innocent lives across America.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Beast: Part 1
Episodes.Description: Bruce Banner returns to civilization but is hunted by General Ross and the Leader's mutated creatures.

Episodes.Title: Man to Man, Beast to Beast

Entries.Title: Princess Sissi: The Animated Series (1997)
Entries.Description: Princess Sissi: The Animated Series chronicles the adventures and romance of young Sissi as she faces challenges, royal intrigue, and adventure on her way to becoming Empress of Austria.

Episodes.Title: First Steps In The Royal Court
Sissi And Franz Keep Their Promises
Sissi In The Eye Of The Storm

Entries.Title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
Entries.Description: Sonic the Hedgehog and his sidekick Tails battle the evil Dr. Robotnik to save animals turned into robots on the planet Mobius.

Episodes.Title: Pilot Episode
Episodes.Description: Unaired pilot episode introducing Sonic, Tails, and Dr. Robotnik's conflict.

Episodes.Title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
Episodes.Description: Robotnik creates a squad to capture Sonic but is outsmarted.

Episodes.Title: Subterranean Sonic
Episodes.Description: Sonic and Tails confront Robotnik in underground caves.

Episodes.Title: Lovesick Sonic
Episodes.Description: Sonic falls for a robot disguised as a princess.

Episodes.Title: Slowwww Going
Episodes.Description: Sonic is slowed down by Robotnik's device while protecting a village.

Episodes.Title: High Stakes Sonic
Episodes.Description: Sonic and Robotnik gamble for control of Mobius in a casino.

Episodes.Title: Sonic Breakout
Episodes.Description: Sonic breaks animals out of Robotnik's factory.

Episodes.Title: Trail of the Missing Tails
Episodes.Description: Tails is kidnapped, forcing Sonic to rescue him.

Episodes.Title: Close Encounter of the Sonic Kind
Episodes.Description: Aliens mistake Sonic for a criminal robot.

Episodes.Title: Momma Robotnik's Birthday
Episodes.Description: Sonic crashes Momma Robotnik's birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Big Daddy
Episodes.Description: Robotnik poses as a wrestling champion to trap Sonic.

Episodes.Title: Sonic's Song
Episodes.Description: A hypnotic song forces Sonic to dance uncontrollably.

Episodes.Title: Birth of a Salesman
Episodes.Description: Sonic sells gadgets to fund his adventures.

Episodes.Title: Best Hedgehog
Episodes.Description: Sonic competes in a contest to prove he's the best.

Episodes.Title: The Robotnik Express
Episodes.Description: Robotnik uses a train to spread roboticizer gas.

Episodes.Title: Too Tail Tails
Episodes.Description: Tails gains extra tails, causing chaos.

Episodes.Title: Tails' New Home
Episodes.Description: Tails considers living in a city of foxes.

Episodes.Title: Over the Hill Hero
Episodes.Description: Sonic is tricked into thinking he's too old to fight.

Episodes.Title: Blank-Headed Eagle
Episodes.Description: Robotnik erases the memory of a superhero eagle.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery of the Missing Hi-Tops
Episodes.Description: Sonic loses his shoes and must find them.

Episodes.Title: So Long Sucker
Episodes.Description: Sonic is targeted by a robotic vacuum cleaner.

Episodes.Title: Sonic Gets Thrashed
Episodes.Description: Sonic is captured and forced to compete in Robotnik's games.

Episodes.Title: Pseudo Sonic
Episodes.Description: Robotnik creates an evil Sonic duplicate.

Episodes.Title: Grounder the Genius
Episodes.Description: Grounder gains intelligence and rebels against Robotnik.

Episodes.Title: Tails in Charge
Episodes.Description: Tails leads a mission when Sonic is injured.

Episodes.Title: Sno Problem
Episodes.Description: Sonic battles Robotnik in a frozen tundra.

Episodes.Title: Submerged Sonic
Episodes.Description: Sonic and Tails stop Robotnik from flooding Mobius.

Episodes.Title: Boogey-Mania
Episodes.Description: Sonic faces a monster created by Robotnik's nightmare machine.

Episodes.Description: Tails must save Sonic from a roboticizer trap.

Episodes.Description: Sonic teams up with a bear warrior against Robotnik.

Episodes.Description: Sonic and Tails vacation at a resort owned by Robotnik.

Episodes.Description: Sonic plays matchmaker for two robots.

Episodes.Description: Robotnik turns animals into hybrid robots at a zoo.

Episodes.Title: Attack on the Pinball Fortress
Episodes.Description: Sonic navigates a pinball-themed fortress.

Episodes.Title: Mass Transit Trouble

Episodes.Description: Sonic competes in Robotnik's rigged robot Olympics.

Episodes.Description: Robotnik becomes a pirate to steal Mobius's treasure.

Episodes.Title: Hedgehog of the Hound Table
Episodes.Description: A medieval-themed adventure with Robotnik as a king.

Episodes.Title: Robotnik's Pyramid Scheme
Episodes.Description: Robotnik traps Sonic in an Egyptian pyramid.

Episodes.Title: Prehistoric Sonic
Episodes.Description: Sonic and Tails travel to prehistoric times.

Episodes.Title: Baby-Sitter Jitters
Episodes.Description: Sonic and Tails babysit a troublesome child.

Episodes.Title: Honey, I Shrunk the Hedgehog
Episodes.Description: Sonic is shrunk and must navigate a giant world.

Episodes.Title: Robotnikland
Episodes.Description: Robotnik opens a theme park to trap animals.

Episodes.Title: The Mobius 5000
Episodes.Description: Sonic races in a high-stakes car competition.

Episodes.Title: The Little Merhog
Episodes.Description: A mermaid-themed parody where Tails saves a merhog.

Episodes.Title: Road Hog
Episodes.Description: Sonic battles a biker gang working for Robotnik.

Episodes.Title: The Robots' Robot
Episodes.Description: Grounder and Scratch build a robot to defeat Sonic.

Episodes.Title: Tails' Tale
Episodes.Description: Tails tells a story of his solo adventure.

Episodes.Title: Hero of the Year
Episodes.Description: Sonic is nominated for an award, but Robotnik sabotages the ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Fast and Easy
Episodes.Description: Sonic takes a job at a fast-food restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Lifestyles of the Sick and Twisted
Episodes.Description: Robotnik hosts a talk show to mock Sonic.

Episodes.Title: Robo-Ninjas
Episodes.Description: Robotnik hires ninja robots to capture Sonic.

Episodes.Title: Sonically Ever After
Episodes.Description: Sonic and Robotnik in a fairy-tale parody finale.

Episodes.Title: Sonic Christmas Blast
Episodes.Description: Sonic saves Christmas from Robotnik's roboticizer.

Entries.Title: Werewolf
Entries.Description: A college student, Eric Cord, becomes a werewolf after being bitten by his cursed roommate. To break the curse, he must hunt down the originator of his bloodline while evading a relentless bounty hunter.

Episodes.Description: Eric seeks refuge in a police station but must control his transformations while surrounded by law enforcement.

Episodes.Title: Friendly Haven
Episodes.Description: Eric takes shelter in a monastery but struggles to control his inner beast.

Episodes.Title: A Different World (Part 2)

Episodes.Description: The series finale: Eric confronts Remy but the outcome remains unresolved due to cancellation.
